Invitation to Participate in CUHK Health Study: Free 12-Week Exercise Guidance and
Comprehensive Health Check!
(Complete the trial and receive a HK$150 shopping voucher)
Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Sports Nutrition and Physical Activity Laboratory
Sender: He Wenke
For any questions, please contact:
wenke.he@link.cuhk.edu.hk
The Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong,
Sports Nutrition and Physical Activity Laboratory,
sincerely invites you to participate in an exercise intervention study! This study will help us understand your exercise metabolic performance and improve your metabolic health.
Study Title
: A Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing the Effects of Different Aerobic Exercise Training on Metabolic and Circulating Blood Indicators in Postmenopausal Women with overweight or obesity
Dear Madam:
With aging and postmenopausal hormonal changes, do you feel that your weight is gradually increasing, fat is easily accumulated, or you begin to worry about health indicators such as body fat and blood lipids? The Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently conducting a study to understand the effects of different aerobic exercise training on metabolic health in postmenopausal women with overweight or obesity. We sincerely invite eligible Chinese women to participate and regain health together through scientific exercise!
By participating in this study, you will receive for free:
1. Comprehensive body composition assessment: accurate measurement of body fat percentage, muscle mass, visceral fat, etc.
2. Professional blood indicator testing: understand your core metabolic indicators such as blood lipids and blood glucose.
3. Expert-level exercise capacity test: accurately measure your exercise metabolic performance to evaluate your physical fitness and metabolic response.
4. 12 weeks of free exercise guidance: full follow‑up by professional researchers to ensure exercise safety and effectiveness.
We are looking for:
1. Chinese women who have been naturally postmenopausal for 12 months or more (less than 6 years since the last menstrual period).
2. Are overweight or obese (BMI ≥ 23 kg/m² or body fat percentage > 30%; will be confirmed by laboratory testing).
3. Are usually physically inactive (less than 150 minutes of moderate‑intensity physical activity, less than 75 minutes of vigorous‑intensity physical activity per week, or an equivalent combination).
4. Have had relatively stable body weight in the past 3 months, and have no serious contraindications to exercise (e.g., severe heart disease, stroke, etc.).
⏳ What do you need to do? (3 assessments + 12‑week intervention training)
This study lasts 12 weeks. Eligible participants will be randomly assigned to a
control group
,
aerobic
exercise group A,
or
aerobic exercise group B
. During the period, you will need to visit the laboratory at The Chinese University of Hong Kong for 3 assessments, including: questionnaire surveys, fasting venous blood draw, finger‑prick blood sampling, body composition measurement, and exercise metabolic testing. To reduce discomfort during testing, the exercise metabolic test will be conducted separately from other health tests. Throughout the study, you will need to come to the laboratory
6 times.
12‑week intervention training: 3 times per week, 40‑70 minutes per session, for 12 weeks.
Upon completion of the study, you will receive a HK$150 shopping voucher and a health report.
Trial location: G02 Office, Ground Floor, Kwok Sports Building, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Register now / Enquire:
Places are limited, first‑come, first‑served! You can click the link below to register:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfZKjSc55Ov13iAjw_GAGkFIbINsXc9rH1ePEYg6CWrU5w5Ew/viewform?usp=header
If you have any questions, please contact the research team:
Study coordinator: Ms. He (WhatsApp: +852 5984 8824)
Supervising professor: Prof. Stephen Heung-sang WONG (Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
Wishing you good health!
Research Team
Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Respectfully

bodyText:

Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students

2026/09/25

Announcements
[Max. HKD$1200] Recruiting Native Cantonese-speaking Grandparents with hearing loss and Grandchildren for an Interaction Experiment [最高可獲HKD$1200][長者認知及聽力測試報告; + 兒童IQ智商測試報告] 招募聽力損失長者及其孫子女參與互動實驗 - Brain and Mind Institute
From: LEUNG Mei Yee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
我們是
香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（BMI）
的研究團隊。我們團隊誠摯邀請有聽力損失的長者及其孫子女來參與一項互動研究。
參與者需符合以下條件：
長者：
65歲或以上，存在聽力損失，
無其他已知認知障礙症狀， 且
有意願配戴助聽器
孩童：
6-9歲
，無其他已知發展問題，母語為廣東話
實驗內容：本實驗共分為兩節（每節約1.5至2小時）：
- 第一節：長者將獨自參與一項
認知及聽力檢測
（當日孫子女無需到場）
- 第二節：長者將與孫子女一同進行
簡單遊戲
，期間我們將使用安全且非侵入性的
「近紅外光譜儀」（fNIRS）
進行腦部掃描
- 請注意：參與者必須先完成第一節的實驗，且結果符合研究要求，方會獲邀參與第二節的實驗
完成整個實驗後，您可獲得：
- 長者：一份
認知能力測試報告
+ 一份
純音聽力測試報告
- 孩童：一份
非語言智商測試報告
+ 一份
價值HKD$80的禮物
報酬：
現金HKD$400-1200
，以及免費停車券（如適用）
實驗地點：香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（位於校園內）
如您對本研究感興趣，請點擊以下連結填寫報名表格：
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
如祖孫兩位初步符合條件，我們將會儘快與您聯絡！
如有疑問，請發送電郵至 meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk，
亦可致電或Whatsapp 95867123 查詢。
我們期待你的參與！
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are researchers from the
Brain and Mind Institute (BMI) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong
. Our team sincerely invites grandparents with hearing loss and their grandchildren for a social interaction study.
Participants need to be:
- Grandparent:
65+ years old with hearing loss
, with no other diagnosed cognitive impairment, interested in fitting hearing aids
- Grandchild:
6-9 years old
with no other developmental problems; speaking Cantonese as the first language
What is involved? The experiment consists of two sessions (approx. 1.5-2 hours each):
- Session 1: The grandparent will participate alone in a
cognitive and hearing test
. (The grandchild does not need to attend)
- Session 2: The grandparent and grandchild will participate together in some
simple games
while using
fNIRS
(
functional near-infrared spectroscopy
, safe and non-invasive!!!) brain scanning device
- NOTE: Participants must first complete Session 1 and meet the study's requirements to be invited to Session 2
What you'll get (upon completion of the entire study):
- For the grandparent:
A cognitive test report
and
a pure-tone audiometry
(hearing test) report
- For the child:
An non-verbal IQ test report
and
a gift (~HKD$80)
Reward:
HKD$400-1200 allowance
and free parking ticket.
Location: Brain and Mind Institute, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (In campus).
If you are interested in our study, please fill in the form below via the following link:
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
We will contact you afterwards if the dyad are suitable.
For inquiries, please contact: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk,
call or Whatsapp 95867123.
We look forward to your participation!
View Count

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

. It aims to investigate the association of mutations in genes, as well as other potential structural variants, with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) in individuals from Hong Kong.

香港中文大學內科及藥物治療學系與香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正聯合進行一項為期36週，以內服中藥(沖劑)治療 2 型糖尿病人
 研究對象：18至80歲華人
沒有重大疾病，沒有服用中藥， 身體質量指數 (BMI) ≥18 kg/m²  (公斤 ÷ 米 ÷ 米)
不吸煙或已戒煙至少 12 個月，如女性目前未懷孕
患糖尿病未滿 6 年，且在過去 3 個月內未使用任何降血糖藥物（包括胰島素）治療
至少具備以下其中一項風險因素:
糖尿病家族史 (尤其父母或兄弟姐妹在40歲前診斷 )
代謝綜合症 (3高：高血糖，高血壓，高膽固醇)
超重或肥胖
脂肪肝
多囊卵巢綜合症
妊娠糖尿病病史
如不確定自己是否患有糖尿病，會安排你服用葡萄糖飲料（75 克口服葡萄糖耐量試驗）
研究內容：中西醫評估、心電圖、肝纖維化掃描、抽血檢查、填寫問卷、服用研究中藥或安慰劑等
地點：新界沙田威爾斯醫院，舊座，3 樓，3M 病房 - 糖尿及內分泌研究中心
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼，名額有限，先到先得！
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名參加：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
如果初步合適參與研究，負責同事將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電  3505 3897 / 6937 3365 或 WhatsApp 6937 3365與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。
[Clinical safety, efficacy and multiomic evaluation of a novel Chinese Medicine formula in Type 2 diabetes: Effects on beta-cell function and insulin resistance
.]
Department of Medicine and Therapeutics and Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK are jointly conducting a 36-week clinical study on the use of oral traditional Chinese medicine (granule form) for treating type 2 diabetes.
Eligibility Criteria: Ethnic Chinese individuals aged 18 to 80 years
No major illnesses, not currently taking any traditional Chinese medicine, and with a Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 18 kg/m² (kg ÷ metre ÷ metre)
Non-smokers or those who have quit smoking for at least 12 months; females must not be currently pregnant
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes for less than 6 years and have not used any glucose-lowering medications (including insulin) in the past 3 months
Must have at least one of the following risk factors:
Family history of diabetes (especially if parents or siblings were diagnosed before age of 40)
Metabolic syndrome (three highs: high blood sugar, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol)
Overweight or obesity
Fatty liver
Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
History of gestational diabetes
If you are unsure whether you have diabetes, a 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) will be arranged for you.

Study Procedures Include:
Chinese and Western medical assessments, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Liver fibrosis scan, Blood tests, Questionnaire completion, Taking either the study Chinese medicine or a placebo
Location: Ward 3M, 3/F, Old Block, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin, New Territories
Free of charge to participate.
Successful participants may receive an allowance of up to HKD $1,000.
Limited quota – first come, first served!
Register via the following link:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692

Career Development & Further Studies Series 2026-27

Fireside Chat with Mrs. Regina Ip
Sharing her personal journey from a civil servant to a prominent political figure and female leader, Mrs. Regina Ip will engage with CUHK students and staff on how to equip ourselves for the future and strive for excellence.

Event Details

Date:
7 Oct 2026 (Wed)
⏰
Time:
2:30 pm – 4:00 pm

Venue:
VR Zone, Learning Garden, CUHK Library

Language:
Cantonese

Guest Speaker:
The Honourable Mrs Regina IP LAU Suk-yee, GBM, GBS, JP
Mrs Ip is currently the Founding-Chairperson of the New People's Party, the Savantas Policy Institute and the Maritime Silk Road Society, as well as Founder of the Global Prosperity Summit, a series of geopolitical conferences. Mrs Ip joined the Administrative Service of the Hong Kong civil service in September 1975 and worked in a wide range of policy areas, including home affairs, security, trade and industry. She rose through the ranks to Director of Bureau in May 2000. She served as Secretary for Security from August 1998 to July 2003. She was also a Legislative Council Member returned by geographical constituency through universal suffrage-based elections from 2008 to 2025. In October 2012 and July 2017, Mrs Ip was appointed Non-Official Member of the Executive Council. Mrs Ip was appointed Convenor of the Non-Official Members of the Executive Council in 2022. She also served as Court Member of the University of Hong Kong from 2019 to 2025. Mrs Ip was awarded the Grand Bauhinia Medal in 2021.

CUHK students, staff, and alumni

Urban Forestry and Public Humanities in Hong Kong  - Centre for Cultural Studies
From: Miss Manuela Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
manuelawong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
“Urban Forestry and Public Humanities in Hong Kong” is an immersive, hands-on program designed for CUHK students to explore the vital role trees play in cooling our streets, cleaning our air, and boosting community well-being. Led by scholars, experts, and artists, you will gain knowledge about our trees and the role they play in our urban and rural environment and ecosystem. You will also learn to develop an aesthetic relationship with our trees by watching them, listening to them, and capturing them in artistic ways. Whether you like trees or community building, you will leave with the tools and knowledge needed to promote urban nature.
Registration is open to all full-time CUHK students, with a quota of 20. Those participants who have completed all activities will be offered a Certificate of Participation – Workshop in Urban Forestry.
Schedule:
OCT 16 (12:00–5:00 PM) — Briefing, Lectures & Tree Walk
LATE OCT to MID NOV — Hands-on Workshops (Small-group)
MID NOV — Exhibition
Registration:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741899
Speakers:
Vincci Mak (Landscape Architecture, HKU)
Ken So (The Conservancy Association)
Sherman Lam (photographer)
Jimmy Ho (CRS, CUHK)
Pang Laikwan (CRS, CUHK)
Important Notes:
1.Priority will be given to students of BA in Public Humanities, Cultural Studies and Cultural Management Programme.
2.Places are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
3.Students must present their own valid student ID card for verification.

Announcements
中醫調治消化系統疾病計劃 | Chinese Medicine Treatment Program for Digestive Diseases  - School of Chinese Medicine
From: CUHK Chinese Medicine Clinics
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cuscmclinics@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港人面臨的腸胃問題
脾胃負責食物的消化與吸收，中醫稱為「後天之本」，是維護身體健康的基礎。脾胃的健康對於氣血的生成和運行具有深遠的影響。脾胃功能強健就能夠更有效地轉化食物中的養分成為氣血，供給身體各器官運用，因此維護其功能至關重要。
香港人因生活節奏快和工作壓力大，加上經常進食酸辣、生冷食物，以及咖啡、奶茶等飲品，容易引發不同的消化系統疾病。
焦慮引發胃痛
在中醫五行學說中，肝屬木，脾屬土。由於木克土的關係，情緒波動（如焦慮，抑鬱，煩躁等）可導致肝氣鬱結、運行不暢，這會進一步妨礙脾胃的運化和吸收的功能，並加劇腸胃不適的症狀。
您是否正受以下腸胃問題困擾？
不少消化系統疾病在初期症狀並不明顯，然而若腸胃不適持續反覆出現，便可能是脾胃失調或潛在消化系統疾病的警號。若您出現以下症狀，不妨尋求註冊中醫師診斷及調理：
胃脹、胃痛、噯氣、食慾不振
反酸、燒心、噁心、口氣重
腹痛、便秘、泄瀉
補虛抗病邪，全方位治療
中醫會根據患者的疾病、症狀、陰陽五行、臟腑失調的情況分析，予以個體化的治療，中藥具有良好的健脾、益胃、補氣、祛濕、化濁等功效。此外，不少研究指出，無論是中藥還是針灸，均有增強胃腸道動力，抑制胃腸道炎症等作用，有助治療腸胃不適的各種狀態。
中大中醫診所現推出中醫調治消化系統疾病計劃，中醫團隊將按個別情況訂定最合適的中醫治療方案。凡參與此計劃，於首三個月內可以優惠價接受下列中醫服務 :

Digestive Health Challenges in Hong Kong
From the perspective of Chinese medicine, the spleen and stomach play an important role in the digestion and absorption of food. Their health has a profound impact on the production and circulation of Qi and blood, enabling the body to convert nutrients into energy and nourishment for various organs. Therefore, maintaining digestive health is vital to overall wellbeing.
Hong Kong's fast-paced lifestyle, high levels of stress, and frequent consumption of coffee, milk tea, as well as greasy, deep-fried, cold or spicy dishes may gradually impair digestive functions.
Are You Experiencing Any of These Digestive Symptoms?
Many gastrointestinal conditions do not show obvious symptoms in their early stages. However, persistent or recurrent digestive discomfort may be a warning sign of an underlying digestive imbalance.
You are encouraged to consult a registered Chinese medicine practitioner if you experience any of the following symptoms:
Bloating, stomach pain, burping or loss of appetite
Acid reflux, heartburn, nausea or bad breath
Abdominal pain, constipation or diarrhea
Chinese medicine practitioners will design a personalised treatment plan based on individual condition and symptoms. Research suggests that Chinese medicines and acupuncture may help improve gastrointestinal motility and reduce gastrointestinal inflammation, supporting the management of a wide range of digestive conditions.
CUSCM Clinics are launching ‘Chinese Medicine Treatment Program for Digestive Diseases’. Under this program, our Chinese medicine practitioner team will discuss with patients and provide tailored treatment plans for individual patients.

creative
and
dynamic

and

From: Catherine So

wingchee@cuhk.edu.hk

Call for Papers
11th Conference of the International Society for Gesture Studies - ISGS 2027
Conference Dates: 14-16 December 2027, Hong Kong
Abstract Submission Dates: July 2, 2026 - November 30, 2026
Conference website:
https://events.polyu.edu.hk/isgs2027/home
Abstract Submission Link:
https://cems.polyu.edu.hk/abstract-submission?id=68&eventId=2DC9D9A1-D4F9-4BD9-9B8C-D5E229D92760
We cordially invite abstracts on topics related to Futures for Gestures within the following thematic areas: “Theory, Practice, Technology, Ecology” and their subthemes.
Theory
Mind, embodiment, and cognition
Perception and social understanding
Psychology and philosophy
Meaning and multimodality
Gesture studies theory
Practice
Knowledge, competence, and skill
Habitualisation, routine, and culture
Learning, pedagogy, and performance
Interaction, conduct, and communication
Intervention, impact, and profession
Technology
Artificial Intelligence, computer vision, and big data
New, digital, and social media
Screen, film, and cinema
Kinematics and capture
Human-Computer Interaction
Ecology
Organism, environment, and nature
Vitality, life, and living
Growth, movement, and process
Relationality and materiality
Dynamic and complex systems
We welcome all submissions that explore these themes and sub-themes.
Presentation Formats:
Paper presentation   20 minutes & 5 minutes Q & A
Poster presentation   Print: Size: A0 (Width: 841mm x Height: 1189mm)
Thematic Panels   90 min slot. Maximum 5 presentations + minimum 15 minutes discussion/ Q & A
Abstract Submission Guidelines for papers and posters:
Abstracts should be anonymous. Please delete all references to the authors.
Each abstract should include the following:
a. Title (max: 15 words)
b. Abstract (max: 350 words excluding references)
c. Citation style: APA (7th edition)
Please submit your abstract online following this format.
For Thematic Panels:
Add the details of the panel chair as the submitting author and of all the authors using the "Add Co-author" function. (Please indicate which contributing authors are also panel co-chairs, if any).
Add a title line with the title of the panel under "Abstract Title".
Upload one document with all the abstracts including a 250-word rationale for the panel + 150 words per paper (max. 5 papers).
Remember to delete all references to the authors.
Each presenter can appear on a maximum of three abstracts (whether paper / poster presentation, panel) and only once as the first author (excluding thematic panels).
Authors should ensure that the same abstract has not been presented at another conference.
Deadline for submission: 30 November 2026, 11:59PM (Hong Kong Time) (UTC+8)
Selection Process
All submissions will undergo a double (or triple) blind review and the first author of accepted submissions will be informed by the beginning of April 2027.
The ISGS will offer a restricted number of bursaries to student presenters, including PhD candidates, at the conference as a waiver of the registration price. Information regarding the application process will be provided following review of conference abstracts.
International Sign interpreting will be provided by Overseas Interpreting. We will inquire about your requirements during registration.
Pre-conference Workshops
Pre-conference workshops are being organised and will take place the day before the conference (December 13th 2027). More information will be shared once available.

isgs2027.hk@polyu.edu.hk
if you have any enquiries.

bodyText:

Announcements
Microsoft Copilot Chat Tips From Blank Page to A+ Essay in 3 Prompts  - ITSC
From: ITSC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
itsc@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Staring at a blank document at 2 AM? We've all been there.
Use Copilot
as your
writing coach
to structure, draft, and polish — turning panic into A+ material!
Prompt 1 — copy & paste it!
Structure it
"Create a detailed argumentative essay outline on [topic]. Include: a compelling hook, clear thesis statement, 3 supporting arguments with evidence types needed, 1 counterargument with rebuttal, and a strong conclusion."
Prompt 2 — keep the conversation going!
Draft the hardest part
"Using this outline, write the introduction and first body paragraph. Use an engaging hook that starts with a surprising statistic or question. Cite format: APA 7th edition."
Prompt 3 — go advanced!
Polish to perfection
"Review this essay draft for: 1) Logical flow 2) Strength of arguments 3) Grammar and clarity 4) Academic tone consistency. Give specific suggestions with rewritten examples."
Why this works:
Breaking writing into Structure → Draft → Polish mirrors professional workflows. Each prompt builds on the last, and you stay in control!

Bonus tip:
After your final draft, try:
"Grade this essay as a strict university professor and tell me what to fix to go from B+ to A+"

Want to enhance your Copilot skills? Check out previous
All IT - Microsoft Copilot Chat Usage Tips
for even more helpful guidance and best practices.

From: Kellie LU

Starting Clinical Research
in Primary Care
? Looking for End-to-End Support?
Primary Care Clinical Trial Unit (PCCTU)
Your Gateway to Primary Care Clinical Trials in Hong Kong
The
Primary Care Clinical Trial Unit (PCCTU)
of the
JC School of Public Health and Primary Care, Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
is an academic clinical trial unit and study site dedicated to advancing high-quality clinical research in primary care.
We support a diverse range of research projects, including:
Drug Clinical Trials (Phase II-IV)
Medical Device Studies
Diagnostic Validation Studies
Real-World Studies (RWS)
Investigator-Initiated Trials (IIT)
Our services cover the full clinical research lifecycle:
Trial Protocol Development and Ethics Submissions
Participant Recruitment, Retention and Follow-up
Full Trial and Data Management
Comprehensive Statistical Analysis
By connecting academia, industry, and patient care, PCCTU facilitates the translation of research findings into meaningful improvements in clinical practice and population health.

Collaboration & Enquiries:
pcctu.sphpc@cuhk.edu.hk

Learn More:
https://sphpc.cuhk.edu.hk/primary-care-clinical-trial-unit/

PCCTU
）
基層醫療臨床試驗的理想合作夥伴
香港中文大學醫學院賽馬會公共衞生及基層醫療學院轄下的基層醫療臨床試驗小組（PCCTU），是一個學術臨床試驗中心及研究基地，致力推動高質素的基層醫療臨床研究發展。
我們支援多元化研究項目，包括：
第二至第四期藥物臨床試驗（Phase II-IV）
醫療器械研究
診斷驗證研究
真實世界研究（RWS）
研究者發起的臨床研究（IIT）
我們提供全面的研究支援服務：
研究方案設計和倫理審批申請
受試者招募、留存及隨訪
臨床試驗實施及數據管理
全面統計分析
透過連結學術界、產業界與病人照護體系，PCCTU 致力促進科研成果轉化，推動循證醫學發展，並為病人健康及公共衞生帶來實際效益。

基層醫療臨床試驗的理想合作夥伴
香港中文大學醫學院賽馬會公共衞生及基層醫療學院轄下的基層醫療臨床試驗小組（PCCTU），是一個學術臨床試驗中心及研究基地，致力推動高質素的基層醫療臨床研究發展。
我們支援多元化研究項目，包括：
第二至第四期藥物臨床試驗（Phase II-IV）
醫療器械研究
診斷驗證研究
真實世界研究（RWS）
研究者發起的臨床研究（IIT）

研究方案設計和倫理審批申請
受試者招募、留存及隨訪
臨床試驗實施及數據管理
全面統計分析

邀請參加本項研究
初步證據顯示, 間歇性飲食（INTD）和高強度間歇運動（HIIE）在改善心血管代謝健康和減重方面存在協同作用。本研究旨在探討INTD和HIIE對體力活動不足的中央肥胖成人的心血管健康影響。
受試者招募
本研究的目標人群為香港體力活動不足的中年成年人（年齡40至64歲），並且具有中央肥胖。中央肥胖將定義為男性腰圍達90厘米（cm）或以上，女性腰圍達80厘米或以上。如果您對任何列出的條件有疑問，請諮詢研究人員。
https://forms.gle/FmCFdyFgdEyudP8k8
如您有任何疑問，可通過以下渠道聯絡這項研究的相關人員：
馬先生
WhatsApp: 39436085
Email: ericaaama@cuhk.edu.hk
Invitation to Participate in Research Study
Preliminary evidence has suggested a synergistic interaction effect of intermittent dieting (INTD) and high intensity interval exercise (HIIE) on cardio-metabolic health and weight loss. This study aims to examine the effects of INTD and HIIE and intermittent dieting for cardiometabolic and cardiovascular fitness in physically inactive adults with central obesity.
Participant Recruitment
The target population of the proposed study will be physically inactive middle-aged adults (aged 40–64 years) with central obesity in Hong Kong. Central obesity will be defined as having a waist circumference 90 centimeters (cm) or above for men and 80 cm or above for women. If you are unsure about any of the listed conditions, then you should consult with the researchers.
https://forms.gle/FmCFdyFgdEyudP8k8

From: Chaplain's Office

學期間逢星期一下午 1:30–1:55，崇基校牧室「午間心靈綠洲」為校園內的老師、同學及各部門職員，留一片可讓呼吸慢下來的光陰。
本場由香港城市室樂團中提琴家容博賢，與中大音樂系鋼琴及古鍵琴導師、施坦威榮譽教師郭家豪博士攜手，演奏舒伯特 1824 年為一種已悄然消失的弓弦吉他「阿佩吉奧內」而寫的《阿佩吉奧內奏鳴曲》（D. 821）。
琴聲如一封遲到兩百年的信，從已無人記得的樂器，改由中提琴的中音緩緩讀出：先是沉吟，再是低語，最後在光明裡輕輕放下。
歡迎前來崇基學院禮拜堂，在這廿多分裡，讓旋律替你把午後重新安放。
Midday Oasis offers a quiet interval each Monday at 1:30–1:55pm in Chung Chi College Chapel—a brief oasis for students, teachers and staff.
Violist Yung Pok Yin of the City Chamber Orchestra of Hong Kong joins pianist Dr. Timothy Kwok, Instructor of Piano and Harpsichord at CUHK and Steinway Honorary Teacher, in Schubert’s Arpeggione Sonata, D. 821: a work written for an instrument that vanished, now given voice by the viola’s warm middle register.
Come and let the music set the afternoon down gently. All are welcome.

Announcements
HK$220 Stipend: Spoken Interaction fNIRS Experiments for Mandarin Native Speakers Aged 18-30 (Approx. 2.5 Hours)  - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: Xiaohui RAO
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
想了解语音互动过程中大脑如何活动吗？欢迎参加我们的无创脑成像研究，在获得实验报酬的同时体验前沿认知科学研究！
本实验室使用安全、无创的功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）系统记录大脑血氧变化。该设备不会对人体造成伤害。如有任何安全顾虑，欢迎联系研究人员了解详情：Miss RAO，1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk。
实验内容及时间：
本研究为语音互动实验。参与者将佩戴安全、无创的功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）设备进行实验，并填写问卷。实验总时长约2小时，其他准备工作0.5小时。被试费为220港元。
实验地点：中文大学梁銶琚楼G层（语言学系）G34实验室。 实验结束后，会通过转数快支付被试费用。
参与者需要符合以下要求：
年龄为18至30岁。
母语为汉语普通话。
听力正常。
无脑损伤、癫痫等神经系统疾病，无身体残疾，且无头皮外伤或感染。
右利手（写字，用筷子等习惯使用右手）。
没有参加过此实验的相关实验。如果不确定可以联系主试确认：Miss RAO,
1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk
。
报名链接：
https://forms.gle/CZu7G4R58tiKjZop9
香港中文大学语言学及现代语言系
如有问题，请联系饶女士（1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk）
This research is endorsed by
Prof. CAI Zhenguang
zhenguangcai@cuhk.edu.hk
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
English Version:
Interested in how the brain responds during spoken interaction? Join our non-invasive brain-imaging study, receive compensation, and experience current research in cognitive science!
This laboratory uses a safe, non-invasive functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) system to record changes in cerebral blood oxygenation. The procedure does not harm participants. If you have any safety concerns, please contact the researcher for further information: Miss RAO, 1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk.
Experiment Content & Duration:
This is a spoken-interaction experiment. Participants will wear a safe, non-invasive functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) device during the experiment and complete questionnaires. The total duration is approximately 2.5 hours, and the participation fee is HK$220.
Experiment location: Room G34, G/F, K.K. Leung Building, The Chinese University of Hong Kong. The subject fee will be paid via FPS at the end of the experiment.
Participants need to meet the following requirements:
Aged 18-30 years.
Native Mandarin Chinese speaker.
Have normal hearing.
No brain injury, epilepsy, or other neurological disorders, and no scalp injury or infection.
Right-handed (writing, using chopsticks, etc.).
Have not participated in the preparatory experiment for this experiment. If you are not sure, you can contact the experimenter to confirm: Miss RAO, 1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk.
Link:
https://forms.gle/CZu7G4R58tiKjZop9
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages,
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
If you have any questions, please contact Miss Rao (1155197282@link.cuhk.edu.hk)

title: Invitation for undergraduate students to participate in "Study on Cultural Diversity and Adaptation among University Students in Hong Kong" [Registration deadline extended to 25 September 2026] 誠邀本科生參與「香港大學生的文化多樣性與適應研究 」[報名截止日期已延至2026年9月25日]
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/18
»
Announcements
Invitation for undergraduate students to participate in "Study on Cultural Diversity and Adaptation among University Students in Hong Kong" [Registration deadline extended to 25 September 2026] 誠邀本科生參與「香港大學生的文化多樣性與適應研究 」[報名截止日期已延至2026年9月25日] - Psychology
From: Alan Tong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
alantong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
您好！心理學系與香港理工大學應用社會科學系研究團隊正合作進行一項香港大學生的文化多樣性與適應研究 ，誠邀您參與。
研究目的是探討香港高等院校學生的文化背景對學業、社會適應等方面的影響，為政策及支援提出發展建議。本研究已獲得香港理工大學倫理委員會的批准（參考編號：HSEARS20250122009）。
參與條件如下：
18歲或以上
現就讀於教資會資助大學（即香港八大其中之一）
本科的全日制學生*，本地與非本地生皆可
能以中文或英文進行閱讀、書寫與交流
*兼讀制學生、交換生和副學位課程的學生不符合參與條件
；
本科一年級學生已額滿
研究活動：
網上問卷調查
問卷包含有關文化取向與認同、語言能力、心理與社會適應、政策態度、健康狀況等方面的問題，完成需時約45分鐘，可於方便的時間自行填寫。完成後可獲得津貼HKD100，將以轉數快或Payme派發。
若有興趣參與，請填寫報名表：
https://hkpuhealthandsocial.au1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_ctN4pvNb9g8jGyq
如有查詢，請聯絡心理學系湯俊逸教授(
alantong@cuhk.edu.hk
) 或 理工大學研究人員陸依晴博士(電郵：
erin.lu@polyu.edu.hk
)。
--------------------------------------------------
Hello! Department of Psychology is collaborating with the Department of Applied Social Sciences at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) on a study on Cultural Diversity and Adaptation among University Students in Hong Kong. We sincerely invites you to participate in this study.
The study aims to examine how university students’ cultural backgrounds influence their academic and social adaptation at Hong Kong’s universities and to generate insights to inform the development of relevant policies and support measures. This study has been approved by the Human Subjects Ethics Application Review System (HSEARS) of PolyU (Reference No.: HSEARS20250122009).
Eligibility criteria:
Aged 18 or above
Currently studying at a UGC‑funded university (i.e., one of Hong Kong’s eight public universities)
Full‑time undergraduate student*, either local or non-local
Able to read, write, and communicate in Chinese or English
*Part‑time students, exchange students, and students of sub-degree programs are not eligible
;
The quota for first-year undergraduate students has been filled.
Research activity:
Online Survey
The survey includes questions about cultural orientation and identity, language proficiency, psychological and social adaptation, policy attitudes, health conditions, etc. It takes about 45 minutes to complete, and participants can complete in their own time. Upon completion, you will receive an HKD 100 allowance, which will be distributed via FPS or PayMe.
If you are interested in participating, please fill in the registration form:
https://hkpuhealthandsocial.au1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_ctN4pvNb9g8jGyq
For inquiries, please contact Prof. Alan Tong at Department of Psychology (
alantong@cuhk.edu.hk
) or Dr Erin Lu (
erin.lu@polyu.edu.hk
) at PolyU.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

From: Hongyan WANG
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155206536@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
感谢您的兴趣！我们正在招募汉语母语者参加一项AI辅助英语写作研究，诚邀符合条件的人士参与。
本研究由香港中文大学语言学及现代语言系开展，参与者需要来到位于梁銶琚楼的语言实验室，完成如下任务：

重塑榕樹凹故事 | 2026年 · 秋季活動
探索山海村落：榕樹凹生態文化導賞
Connecting Heritage and Nature: Yung Shue Au Eco-Cultural Tour
活動詳情 / Activity Details
日期 / Date：2026年10月24日(星期六) / 24 October 2026 (Sat）
時間 / Time ：1300 - 1615
地點 / Venue：榕樹凹 / Yung Shue Au
集合地點 / Meeting Point：沙頭角避風塘 Sha Tau Kok Typhoon Shelter https://share.google/POni3sD7Hm9uTNH64
費用 / Fee：全免 / Free of charge
(包括來回榕樹凹之船費及保險 / Including round-trip boat transportation to and from Yung Shue Au and insurance)
名額 / Quota：12
報名/ Registration：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13742105
About / 簡介:
榕樹凹是一座歷史悠久的客家村落。這裡同時匯聚了海岸、紅樹林、淡水溪流及次生林，是一處承載著豐富自然生態與人文記憶的山海村落。隨著村民陸續外遷，現時村內已無人常住，村落空間隨之逐步回歸自然演替。
本次導賞由生態學者 Kelvin 與榕樹凹文化大使帶領，我們將步行「榕樹凹生態文化徑」，沿途觀察認識動植物，並探討昔日村民如何利用周邊豐富的自然資源建立聚落生活。歡迎對歷史文化、鄉郊保育及生態觀察感興趣的朋友參加。
Yung Shue Au is a historic Hakka village. Bringing together coastlines, mangroves, freshwater streams, and secondary forests, it is a unique coastal settlement where natural ecology and human memories intertwine. As residents gradually moved out over the years, the village now has no permanent inhabitants, and its spaces have been undergoing natural succession.
Led by ecologist Kelvin and Yung Shue Au Cultural Ambassadors, this tour will take participants along the Yung Shue Au Eco-Cultural Trail to observe local plants and wildlife along the way, while discussing how past residents established their village life in relation to the utilization of surrounding natural resources. Anyone interested in history, countryside conservation, and nature observation is welcome to join.
注意 / Notice：
參加者需自行安排來往沙頭角之交通
Participants should arrange their own transportation to Sha Tau Kok。
參加者需自行上網申請邊境禁區許可證：
Participants must apply for the Closed Area Permit online themselves:
https://www.es.police.gov.hk/
是次活動是香港中文大學建築學院「重塑榕樹凹故事」項目的一部分，並由鄉郊保育辦公室 (#CCO) #鄉郊保育資助計劃 (#CCFS) 資助。
This activity is a part of "Re-telling the Yung Shue Au Story", a project by CUHK School of Architecture, sponsored by the #CountrysideConservationOffice (CCO) and the #CountrysideConservationFundingScheme (CCFS).

Important Notice for Students Planning to Minor in HKSL – Minor Requirement   - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
bmbl@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear students who are planning to take
Hong Kong Sign Language IV
or
Hong Kong Sign Language III & IV
,
If you are considering pursuing a Minor in Hong Kong Sign Language in the future, we would like to bring the following course code changes and minor requirements to your attention. The following courses were changed in 2025-26:
Hong Kong Sign Language IV has been changed from HKSL3000 to HKSL2002
Hong Kong Sign Language III & IV has been changed from HKSL3050 to HKSL2003
Please note that
HKSL2002
and
HKSL2003
are no longer 3000-level courses. Please review your study plan and take other eligible 3000-level courses to satisfy this criterion if necessary.
For the detailed study scheme applicable to your year of admission, please refer to the Undergraduate Student Handbook available
here
. Under
Academic Program,
search for
"LING"
and select

title: "Mind Bathing" — Mindful Forest Connection Guide Training Scheme 中大【心·淋浴】靜觀大自然連結嚮導培訓計劃
bodyText:
Mass Mail System

Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students

2026/09/18

Announcements
"Mind Bathing" — Mindful Forest Connection Guide Training Scheme 中大【心·淋浴】靜觀大自然連結嚮導培訓計劃 - Department of Educational Administration and Policy
From: Cheng Man Sze
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Mind Bathing 】Mindful Forest Bathing Guide Training Programme
This programme will guide students in a forest bathing experience at CUHK on 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday) , enabling participants to learn how to connect body and mind through nature. Upon completion, participants will acquire the foundational skills to lead junior secondary students in forest bathing experiences, helping adolescents build psychological resilience and mindfulness in their school lives. CUHK students who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to participate in the training and to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing and mindfulness practices on the activity day.
Programme Overview
"Mind Bathing" aims to promote the application of forest bathing (Shinrin-yoku) and nature-based mindfulness in school settings. Through direct experience, participants will learn how to harness the natural environment to enhance physical and mental well-being, and apply these learnings in future educational or community service contexts.
Eligibility Criteria
Undergraduate or postgraduate student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (all faculties welcome)
Interest in or basic knowledge of forest bathing, mindfulness, or nature-based healing
Able to attend the full forest bathing training session (14 Dec 2026, 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) and at least two mindfulness workshops.
Able to attend the "Mind Bathing" activity on 16 Dec (2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing
Proficient in Cantonese
Sense of responsibility and openness to learning
Interview Arrangements
Date: Mid of October 2026 (specific dates will be notified individually after registration)
Format: Zoom video interview (approximately 5–10 minutes)
Language: Primarily Cantonese
Training Components
1) "Mind Bathing" Guide Training Workshop
Date: 14 Dec 2026 (Monday)/15 Dec 2026(Tuesday ) (Backup)
Time: 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
2) Mind-Body Connection Mindfulness Workshops
Each student guide must attend a minimum of two mindfulness workshops.
Dates:
Mindfulness Foundations: 3 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
Cultivating Emotional Awareness: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
The Wisdom of the Heart: 17 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Connecting with the World: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Venue: CUHK campus (Chung Chi campus), indoor and outdoor
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
3) "Mind Bathing" Junior Secondary Student Service
Date: 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday)/17 Dec 2026(Thursday ) (Backup)
Time: 2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
Programme Content:
Walk along CUHK nature trails to experience forest bathing and connect with nature
Learn mindfulness attitudes and techniques to connect with the present moment
Acquire knowledge and practical applications of psychological resilience
Understand the basic concepts and practices of nature-based healing
Experience engaging with nature through the five senses (sight, hearing, smell, touch, taste)
Introduction to basic guiding techniques and considerations for leading group activities
Fee: Free of charge
Application Method: Applicants please fill in the form by 2026/10/7.
Form Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQGY_OYTa5MSP-wAGrdnm3amX5k1TZP0GZyjkkdmm9Dpftbg/viewform?usp=header
Programme Facilitators
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze
Registered Secondary School Teacher
Promoting mindfulness among undergraduate, pre-service, and in-service teachers since 2007
Senior Lecturer, Department of Educational Administration and Policy, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Partner Organisation: Nature Bathing
A social enterprise with a professional team of forest bathing guides
Specialises in delivering immersive nature-based experiences to help urban dwellers relieve stress
Expert in guiding participants to connect with nature through the five senses for holistic healing
The event is organized by Department of Educational Administration and Policy in CUHK, with the support of the Sustainable Development Goals Action Fund.
Important Notes
Participants are advised to wear comfortable clothing and sports shoes suitable for outdoor activities
In the event of inclement weather, a contingency date or indoor alternative activities will be arranged
Participants who complete the training and service will receive a certificate of attendance acknowledging their training and service hours
This programme is educational in nature and does not constitute clinical treatment
The video of summer session of Mind Bathing Programme is available for watching now!
"Mind Bathing" Video link:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ProyYH4DxccHd1u54Qof6Mlb65IbUnMS/view?usp=sharing
"Mind Bathing" Guide training session video:
https://youtu.be/Wkn2CcHWLqs?si=1sR8j6hKCVUeHBof
Enquiries
For any enquiries regarding this programme, please contact Ms. Cheng:
Email: 1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Programme Coordinators:
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze ; Mr. Wong Chun Kai; Ms. Wong Hiu Lam
Faculty of Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
We look forward to walking with you into the woods and experiencing the healing power of nature!
【心·淋浴 】靜觀森林浴嚮導培訓計劃
"Mind Bathing" — Mindful Forest Bathing Guide Training Scheme
本計劃將於2026年12月16日（三）帶領學生在中大進行森林浴體驗，讓參加者學習如何透過大自然連結身心，並在培訓後具備基本能力，帶領初中學生體驗森林浴，協助青少年在校園生活中建立心理韌性與靜觀能力。現邀請符合條件的中大學生進行培訓及於活動當日帶領初中生體驗森林浴及學習正念。
計劃簡介
「心·淋浴」計劃旨在推廣森林浴 (Shinrin-yoku) 及大自然靜觀在校園的應用。參加者將透過親身體驗，學習如何運用大自然環境促進身心靈健康，並將所學應用於未來的教育或社區服務場景。
招募對象
- 香港中文大學本科生及研究生（就讀任何學科均可）
- 對森林浴、正念或大自然療癒有興趣或具備基本認識
- 能夠出席完整一節森林浴培訓（12月14日 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. 以及至少兩節正念工作坊
- 能出席12月16日下午1:00-5:00 的「心·淋浴」的活動，帶領初中學生體驗森林浴
- 能夠說利廣東話
- 具備責任心及開放態度
面試安排
日期： 2026年 10月中旬（具體日期將於報名後個別通知）
形式： Zoom 視像面試（約5-10分鐘）
語言： 廣東話為主
培訓內容
1） 「心·淋浴」嚮導培訓工作坊
日期： 2026年12月14日（一）/2026年12月15日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
2） 心身連結正念工作坊
每位學生嚮導最少要參加兩節正念體驗工作坊。
日期：
- 正念基礎 2026年11月3日（二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm (必須出席)
- 覺察情緒 2026年11月10日 (二） 12:30 pm to 2:00 pm(必須出席)
- 智慧的心 2026年11月17日 (二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm
- 連結世界 2026年11月24日 (二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm
地點：香港中文大學校園 (崇基校園)（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
3） 「心·淋浴」帶領初中學生服務
日期： 2026年12月16日（三）/2026年12月17日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
內容包括：
1） 遊走中大校園自然徑，體驗森林浴，連結大自然
2） 學習正念(靜觀)(mindfulness)態度和技巧，連結當下身心靈
3） 學習心理韌性 (Resilience) 相關知識與應用
4） 認識大自然療癒的基本概念與實踐方法
5） 體驗如何透過五感（視、聽、嗅、觸、味）與自然對話
6） 簡單導賞技巧及帶領小組活動的注意事項

【Mind Bathing 】Mindful Forest Bathing Guide Training Programme
This programme will guide students in a forest bathing experience at CUHK on 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday) , enabling participants to learn how to connect body and mind through nature. Upon completion, participants will acquire the foundational skills to lead junior secondary students in forest bathing experiences, helping adolescents build psychological resilience and mindfulness in their school lives. CUHK students who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to participate in the training and to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing and mindfulness practices on the activity day.
Programme Overview
"Mind Bathing" aims to promote the application of forest bathing (Shinrin-yoku) and nature-based mindfulness in school settings. Through direct experience, participants will learn how to harness the natural environment to enhance physical and mental well-being, and apply these learnings in future educational or community service contexts.
Eligibility Criteria
Undergraduate or postgraduate student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (all faculties welcome)
Interest in or basic knowledge of forest bathing, mindfulness, or nature-based healing
Able to attend the full forest bathing training session (14 Dec 2026, 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) and at least two mindfulness workshops.
Able to attend the "Mind Bathing" activity on 16 Dec (2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing
Proficient in Cantonese
Sense of responsibility and openness to learning
Interview Arrangements
Date: Mid of October 2026 (specific dates will be notified individually after registration)
Format: Zoom video interview (approximately 5–10 minutes)
Language: Primarily Cantonese
Training Components
1) "Mind Bathing" Guide Training Workshop
Date: 14 Dec 2026 (Monday)/15 Dec 2026(Tuesday ) (Backup)
Time: 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
2) Mind-Body Connection Mindfulness Workshops
Each student guide must attend a minimum of two mindfulness workshops.
Dates:
Mindfulness Foundations: 3 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
Cultivating Emotional Awareness: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
The Wisdom of the Heart: 17 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Connecting with the World: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Venue: CUHK campus (Chung Chi campus), indoor and outdoor
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
3) "Mind Bathing" Junior Secondary Student Service
Date: 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday)/17 Dec 2026(Thursday ) (Backup)
Time: 2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
Programme Content:
Walk along CUHK nature trails to experience forest bathing and connect with nature
Learn mindfulness attitudes and techniques to connect with the present moment
Acquire knowledge and practical applications of psychological resilience
Understand the basic concepts and practices of nature-based healing
Experience engaging with nature through the five senses (sight, hearing, smell, touch, taste)
Introduction to basic guiding techniques and considerations for leading group activities
Fee: Free of charge
Application Method: Applicants please fill in the form by 2026/10/7.

Dr. Lau Ngar Sze
Registered Secondary School Teacher
Promoting mindfulness among undergraduate, pre-service, and in-service teachers since 2007
Senior Lecturer, Department of Educational Administration and Policy, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Partner Organisation: Nature Bathing
A social enterprise with a professional team of forest bathing guides
Specialises in delivering immersive nature-based experiences to help urban dwellers relieve stress
Expert in guiding participants to connect with nature through the five senses for holistic healing
The event is organized by Department of Educational Administration and Policy in CUHK, with the support of the Sustainable Development Goals Action Fund.
Important Notes
Participants are advised to wear comfortable clothing and sports shoes suitable for outdoor activities
In the event of inclement weather, a contingency date or indoor alternative activities will be arranged

This programme is educational in nature and does not constitute clinical treatment

We are now inviting Hong Kong young adults to participate in a bereavement survey, titled “Trajectories of grief outcomes and the associated psychosocial predictors among recently bereaved young adults in Hong Kong: A retrospective longitudinal mixed-methods approach”. Participants will receive up to HK$300 coupons upon completion.
Participant Inclusion Criteria:
Local young adults aged 18 to 29 residing in Hong Kong.
Have experienced the death of a close friend/relative or an important person within the past 18 months.
Able to read Chinese and communicate in Cantonese.
1) Baseline Questionnaire
- After signing the consent form, participants will complete a 20-minute baseline questionnaire.
- The questionnaire will include questions about grieving process in response to the death of a loved one or significant person, and attitudes toward death
- Participants will receive HK$100 coupons for completing the baseline questionnaire.
2) First Follow-up Questionnaire
- Six months later, participants who have completed the baseline questionnaire will be invited to complete a follow-up questionnaire.
- Participants who complete the first follow-up questionnaire will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.

參加者將進行為期 8 週的光治療，期間將有精神科醫生及研究團隊全程跟進，提供專業評估及指導。
參加可獲：
費用全免：所有治療及評估免費。
交通津貼：完成全部研究評估，最高可獲 HKD$1400。
合資格人士需：
年齡 12 至 19 歲
正受抑鬱情緒困擾
習慣成日好夜瞓

請即掃描海報上 QR Code，或點擊下面連結，用 1-3 分鐘填寫簡單問卷作初步篩查。

title: [Taster Event] AI Supercycle Finance Lab with IBCE and ABS - Transfer-in Business Programmes
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/18
»
Announcements
[Taster Event] AI Supercycle Finance Lab with IBCE and ABS - Transfer-in Business Programmes  - Global Business Programmes, CUHK Business School
From: Global Business Programmes
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
denniswong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear first-year students,
Ready to transform your university experience and stand out in today’s competitive business landscape?
The
International Business and Chinese Enterprise (IBCE)
and
Asian Business Studies (ABS)
transfer-in programmes are designed to cultivate regional expertise across diverse business contexts, while developing career readiness, professional networks, and focused skill sets.
To experience firsthand how IBCE and ABS can help you achieve your goals, we invite you to join our exclusive taster event - the
AI Supercycle Finance Lab
!
The AI Supercycle Finance Lab is a series of workshops designed to help you build the financial and industry judgement needed to analyze AI like an investor. Our first workshop will begin with a lecture by
Dr. Anson AU YEUNG
, Programme Director of IBCE and ABS, on the AI stack — from semiconductors and infrastructure to power, models, and applications. You will learn where the bottlenecks are today, where they may move next, and why these shifts matter for portfolio allocation.
Mr. David CHOW
, Equity Research Associate at UBS, covering China Tech — Telecom, Hardware and Semiconductors, will then teach on Technology & Semiconductors, giving you a closer look at how an equity research analyst assesses the AI build-out, industry structure, and investment opportunities.
AI Supercycle Finance Lab (Session 1)
Date: 7 October 2026 (Wed)
Time: 18:45 – 20:30
Venue: CYT 209B
Seats are limited. Register
here
by 27 September
and join IBCE and ABS students for a rewarding learning experience. Successful applicants will receive a confirmation email
by 2 October
.
Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact Mr. Dennis Wong, Programme Manager, Global Business Programmes at
denniswong@cuhk.edu.hk
.
Best regards,
Global Business Programmes
Undergraduate Office
CUHK Business School
4/F, Cheng Yu Tung Building, 12 Chak Cheung Street, Shatin, Hong Kong

How is your year going? Local post-secondary student well-being survey (complete the questionnaire and get a HK$100 voucher) 今年過得怎樣？本地大專生幸福感調查（填問卷攞 HK$100禮券） - JC School of Public Health and Primary Care (endorsed by Prof. Jean H. Kim)
From: Melinda Chuchu Liu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155201160@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
生活充實定係空虛？課程有趣但一諗到未來職涯頭都大埋？
親愛的同學們，中大公共衞生及基層醫療學院研究團隊誠邀你參與一項本地大專學生幸福感和心理健康調查。花 15-20 分鐘分享你的幸福感同壓力，完成問卷並通過有效性檢核的受訪者可得 HK$100 萬寧/麥當勞/Sephora/Pacific Coffee禮券或電子禮品卡！不需要高談闊論，只需要你真實的感受。
符合以下
4
個條件即可參與
：
18-24 歲的香港永久性居民
本地全日制學士（Degree）或副學位（Asso/HD）課程學生（請在問卷中填寫學生電郵，僅用於資格檢核和發放禮券）
能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文
能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫線上問卷
數據嚴格保密，参与完全自願，可以隨時停止。每位受訪者只能參與和領取酬謝一次。
本調查已獲香港中文大學調查及行為研究操守委員會批准（倫理批准編號：SBRE-23-0714）。如有任何疑問、意見或憂慮，歡迎聯絡研究團隊成員劉楚楚（melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk）。

Is life fulfilling or empty? Finding classes interesting but having a headache for your future career?
Dear students, the research team from the CUHK School of Public Health and Primary Care cordially invites you to participate in a survey on the well-being and mental health of local post-secondary students
Spend 15-20 minutes sharing your feelings and concerns, and receive a HK$100 voucher or e-gift card (choose from Mannings, McDonald's, Pacific Coffee, or Sephora) after completing the online survey and passing the validity check! No fancy words needed—just your most honest feelings.
You are eligible to participate if you meet these 4 criteria:
HK permanent resident aged 18-24
Local full-time undergraduate (Bachelor's Degree) or sub-degree (Associate Degree / Higher Diploma) programme student (please enter your institutional email address in the questionnaire, only for eligibility checking and incentive distribution purposes)
Able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English
Able to complete the online survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer
Data is strictly confidential, participation is entirely voluntary, and you can withdraw at any time. Each participant may participate and collect their incentive only once
. This study has been approved by the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Ethics Approval Ref. No.: SBRE-23-0714). For any questions, feedback, or concerns, please contact Melinda Chuchu Liu at melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk.

title: 【Hybrid Lecture】The Characteristics of "Humanistic" Application in Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Lyric Creations 【Hybrid Lecture】星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質

Announcements
【Hybrid Lecture】The Characteristics of "Humanistic" Application in Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Lyric Creations 【Hybrid Lecture】星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質 - Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
From: 人間佛教研究中心 Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cshb@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質
時間：11月19日 | 週四 14:30 - 16:30
講者：林仁昱教授 | 中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741303
演講簡介：
星雲大師在倡議與實踐「人間佛教」的道路上，不僅以歌曲來推廣理念，許多歌曲也成為導引新時代儀節與活動的重要部分。從1950年代作〈西方〉以取代念佛共修的傳統迴向四句偈，作〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉來適應建立「佛化家庭」的重要典儀；1970年代作〈三寶頌〉濃縮歷代各種〈三皈依〉偈讚歌詞要義，更方便傳唱應用；到2000年以後，創作眾多「人間音緣」歌詞，廣徵作曲，使相同歌詞可有不同風格的譜曲，靈活運用於各種弘法與社會活動，充分表現「人間」應用的特質。本次講座將順著時代脈絡，剖析歌詞內涵與實際應用情形，論述其具體意義及影響力。
On his path of advocating and practicing "Humanistic Buddhism," Venerable Master Hsing Yun not only promoted Buddhist concepts through songs, but many of his musical works also became essential components guiding rituals and activities in the modern era.
Historically, this practical approach unfolded across several key stages: In the 1950s, he composed Western Land (〈西方〉) to replace the traditional four-line verse for the dedication of merit during collective chanting cultivation, and penned the Blessing Song for Buddhist Weddings (〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉) to accommodate the pivotal rituals of establishing "Buddhist Families." In the 1970s, he authored the Ode to the Triple Gem (〈三寶頌〉), which condensed the essential meanings of various historical verses praising the Three Refuges into a format more accessible for singing and collective use. From 2000 onward, he created numerous lyrics for Sounds of the Human World (「人間音緣」) and openly solicited musical compositions, allowing the same lyrics to be adapted into diverse musical styles and flexibly utilized in various Dharma propagation and social events. This approach fully exemplifies the characteristics of "humanistic" and practical application.
Following a chronological framework, this lecture will analyze the inner connotations and practical applications of these lyrics, discussing their concrete significance and far-reaching influence.
嘉賓簡介：
林仁昱，中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任，以佛教文學與文化、敦煌文獻與文學、歌謠俗曲與風俗為研究領域，重要著作有：《敦煌佛教歌曲之研究》、《廿世紀初中國俗曲唱述人物》、《敦煌佛教讚歌寫本「原生態」與應用研究》，近期刊登於期刊的單篇著作有：〈星雲大師1950－70年代佛教歌詞創作探究〉、〈星雲大師「人間音緣」歌詞的文學表現及其效應〉、〈《觀音十二圓覺》的菩薩化身與度化對象探究〉、〈觀音與地藏組合供奉的信仰意義與衍發現象〉、〈現代東亞佛誕節文藝與文化考察—以臺灣、日本、馬來西亞為探究核心〉等。

題目：
星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質
時間：11月19日 | 週四 14:30 - 16:30
講者：林仁昱教授 | 中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741303
演講簡介：
星雲大師在倡議與實踐「人間佛教」的道路上，不僅以歌曲來推廣理念，許多歌曲也成為導引新時代儀節與活動的重要部分。從1950年代作〈西方〉以取代念佛共修的傳統迴向四句偈，作〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉來適應建立「佛化家庭」的重要典儀；1970年代作〈三寶頌〉濃縮歷代各種〈三皈依〉偈讚歌詞要義，更方便傳唱應用；到2000年以後，創作眾多「人間音緣」歌詞，廣徵作曲，使相同歌詞可有不同風格的譜曲，靈活運用於各種弘法與社會活動，充分表現「人間」應用的特質。本次講座將順著時代脈絡，剖析歌詞內涵與實際應用情形，論述其具體意義及影響力。
On his path of advocating and practicing "Humanistic Buddhism," Venerable Master Hsing Yun not only promoted Buddhist concepts through songs, but many of his musical works also became essential components guiding rituals and activities in the modern era.
Historically, this practical approach unfolded across several key stages: In the 1950s, he composed Western Land (〈西方〉) to replace the traditional four-line verse for the dedication of merit during collective chanting cultivation, and penned the Blessing Song for Buddhist Weddings (〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉) to accommodate the pivotal rituals of establishing "Buddhist Families." In the 1970s, he authored the Ode to the Triple Gem (〈三寶頌〉), which condensed the essential meanings of various historical verses praising the Three Refuges into a format more accessible for singing and collective use. From 2000 onward, he created numerous lyrics for Sounds of the Human World (「人間音緣」) and openly solicited musical compositions, allowing the same lyrics to be adapted into diverse musical styles and flexibly utilized in various Dharma propagation and social events. This approach fully exemplifies the characteristics of "humanistic" and practical application.
Following a chronological framework, this lecture will analyze the inner connotations and practical applications of these lyrics, discussing their concrete significance and far-reaching influence.

林仁昱，中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任，以佛教文學與文化、敦煌文獻與文學、歌謠俗曲與風俗為研究領域，重要著作有：《敦煌佛教歌曲之研究》、《廿世紀初中國俗曲唱述人物》、《敦煌佛教讚歌寫本「原生態」與應用研究》，近期刊登於期刊的單篇著作有：〈星雲大師1950－70年代佛教歌詞創作探究〉、〈星雲大師「人間音緣」歌詞的文學表現及其效應〉、〈《觀音十二圓覺》的菩薩化身與度化對象探究〉、〈觀音與地藏組合供奉的信仰意義與衍發現象〉、〈現代東亞佛誕節文藝與文化考察—以臺灣、日本、馬來西亞為探究核心〉等。

題目：
人間佛教的新博物館學實踐:星雲大師的博物館情懷
時間：11月4日 | 週三 10:00 - 12:00
講者：張譽騰教授 | 國立台南藝術大學博物館學研究所兼任教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：現場講座 & ZOOM網絡會議
地點：香港中文大學馮景禧樓 & 會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741301
演講簡介：
「人間佛教」主張佛法不離世間，強調將佛法落實在日常生活，服務社會，讓佛教從山林走入社會，此正與新博物館學訴求遙相呼應。星雲大師是宗教開創者，但很少人知道他在博物館方面也建樹良多，疊有新意。本講座將從三個面向探討大師在新博物館學的成就:
一、從生態博物館角度說明整座佛光山其實就是一座無牆博物館。
二、從博物館與科技、社區和永續三個層次，說明佛陀紀念館成立迄今，如何與時俱進，踐行新博物館學理念。
三、從佛光山核心館與衛星館發展策略談佛光緣美術館群如何與在地道場結合，將佛光山能量有效輻射出去。
"Humanistic Buddhism" advocates that the Buddha-Dharma is not separate from the world, emphasizing the implementation of Buddhist teachings in daily life, serving society, and guiding Buddhism from isolated mountains into secular society. This philosophy echoes the core pursuits of "New Museology."
While Venerable Master Hsing Yun is widely recognized as a religious pioneer, few are aware of his profound achievements and innovative ideas in the field of museum studies.This presentation will explore the Master’s achievements in New Museology through three main dimensions:
1. The Ecomuseum Perspective: Illustrating how the entirety of Fo Guang Shan functions as a "Museum without Walls."
2. Technology, Community, and Sustainability: Examining how the Fo Guang Shan Buddha Museum has kept pace with the times since its inception, putting the principles of New Museology into practice.
3. Core and Satellite Museum Development Strategy: Discussing how the Fo Guang Yuan Art Galleries integrate with local Buddhist centers (dojos) to effectively radiate Fo Guang Shan's energy outward.
嘉賓簡介：
張譽騰教授，畢業於國立台灣大學動物學系，1992年獲得英國萊斯特大學(University of Leicester)博物館學博士。曾任國立台南藝術大學博物館學研究所教授和文博學院院長、行政院文化建設委員會政務副主委、國立歷史博物館館長、中華民國博物館學會理事長、佛光大學講座教授。主要學術著作有: 《當代博物館探索》、《博物館大勢觀察》、《生態博物館:一個文化運動的興起》。現為國立台南藝術大學博物館學研究所兼任教授，並擔任佛光山顧問與學術委員會委員。

題目：
太虛大師的世界佛教運動與文明論述：1920年代為中心
時間：10月27日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：龔雋教授 | 中山大學哲學系教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741299
演講簡介：
本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.
嘉賓簡介：
龔雋教授，現任中山大學哲學系教授、中華外國哲學史學會東方哲學專業委員會副主任、中國社科院評價研究院宗教專業委員會委員，並擔任《新史學》、《漢語佛學評論》、《人文宗教研究》等多種學術刊物編委。主要從事中國佛教思想的教學與研究，代表性著作包括《作為「知識」的近代佛學史論——在東亞視域內的知識史論述》（商務印書館，2019，合著）、《中國禪學研究入門》（復旦大學出版社，2009，合著）及《禪史鉤沉：以問題為中心的思想史論述》（北京三聯書店，2006）。另於海內外學術刊物發表論文四十餘篇。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
太虛大師的世界佛教運動與文明論述：1920年代為中心
時間：10月27日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：龔雋教授 | 中山大學哲學系教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741299
演講簡介：
本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.

為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
從生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的關係看人間佛教
時間：10月20日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：唐忠毛教授 | 華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741297
演講簡介：
生活邏輯立足世俗現實，講求日常責任、人倫倫理，以現世生活價值及時代說變遷為導向，佛教信仰邏輯依託佛教義理，以緣起性空、因果解脫、菩薩利他為終極追求，具備出世超越性。人間佛教的核心，就是以中道的立場調和二者的對立割裂，實現入世生活與出世信仰的辯證統一。星雲大師糾正了傳統佛教理解上的兩種偏差：一是偏重信仰邏輯、消極出世，將修行等同於遠離俗世、逃避現實責任，否定現世生活的修行；二是被生活邏輯裹挾，信仰徹底世俗功利化。人間佛教秉持中道立場，主張佛法不離世間覺。一方面，以生活邏輯為信仰的根基，修行不脫離日常起居、家庭倫理與社會事務，強調在人間踐行善行、擔當責任，把世俗生活作為修行道場，認可現世人生的改造價值。另一方面，以信仰邏輯引領淨化世俗生活，秉持“以出世精神做入世事業”，用慈悲、無我、緣起智慧破除世間功利執著，把日常生活昇華為自利利他的菩薩行。要言之，人間佛教不脫離世間、不執著世間，以世俗生活承載信仰實踐，以終極信仰安頓現實人生，完成了生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的融合統一，也適配當代的社會理念。
The "logic of life" is grounded in secular reality, emphasizing daily responsibilities and human ethics, guided by the values of worldly life and temporal changes. Conversely, the "logic of Buddhist faith" relies on Buddhist doctrines, with the ultimate pursuit of dependent origination, emptiness of nature, karmic cause and effect, liberation, and Bodhisattva altruism, possessing a transcendent and world-transcending nature. The core of Humanistic Buddhism lies in using a Middle Way stance to reconcile the opposition and fragmentation between the two, achieving a dialectical unity of world-engaging life and world-transcending faith.
Venerable Master Hsing Yun corrected two deviations in the traditional understanding of Buddhism: first, an overemphasis on the logic of faith leading to passive world-transcendence, equating spiritual cultivation with escaping secular life and evading realistic responsibilities; second, being overwhelmed by the logic of life, leading to the complete secularization and utilitarianism of faith. Humanistic Buddhism upholds the Middle Way stance, asserting that the Buddha-Dharma is not separate from worldly awakening.
On one hand, it treats the logic of life as the foundation of faith, where spiritual practice is intertwined with daily routines, family ethics, and social affairs, emphasizing the practice of wholesome deeds and taking on responsibilities in the human world, thereby transforming secular life into a place of spiritual cultivation (dojo). On the other hand, it guides and purifies secular life through the logic of faith, adhering to the principle of "engaging in worldly enterprises with a world-transcending spirit," using compassion, selflessness, and the wisdom of dependent origination to eradicate worldly and utilitarian attachments. In short, Humanistic Buddhism neither detaches from nor clings to the world; it uses secular life to carry out faith practices and uses ultimate faith to settle reality-based life, completing the integration and unity of the logic of life and the logic of faith, while adapting to contemporary social philosophies.
嘉賓簡介：
唐忠毛教授，哲學博士、歷史學博士後。現任華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師，華東師範大學區域文化資源與應用研究中心主任、華東師範大學宗教與社會研究中心副主任。兼任中國宗教學會理事、上海市宗教學會副會長。研究領域集中於佛教學、信仰民俗學、區域文化學等。出版專著多本發表論文多篇，代表論著有《佛教本覺思想論爭的現代性考察》（2006）《中國佛教近代轉型的社會之維——民間上海居士佛教篇組織與慈善研究》（2013）《從空性到體用——中國佛教心性本體論的建構與反思》（2019）等。主持國家社科基金重點、一般等項目多項，參與重大專案多項。近年來完成的國家社科基金項目成果包括《佛教中國化的民間民俗向度研究》《江南“廟-鎮”信仰空間與地方社會研究》等。

題目：
行腳足跡與寫作字迹：星雲大師的文學考察
時間：10月6日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：李瑞騰教授 | 中央大學中文系榮譽教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：現場講座 & ZOOM網絡會議
地點：香港中文大學馮景禧樓 & 會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741745
演講簡介：
星雲大師日夜俯首為文；視力衰退以後改以口述，出口成章，成就了豐碩的《星雲大師全集》。其中的「文學」，除第五類「文叢」，尚有第六類「傳記」、第七類「日記」、第八類「書信」，。以文類來說，有詩、散文（含雜文、日記、書信等）、報導文學、傳記、小說等，另口述部分，將以「口述」界定之。這些「字迹」（文字之迹）對應他全球行腳「足跡」，才是圓滿的星雲大師，星雲文學考察的重要性，於焉可見。
Day and night, Venerable Master Hsing Yun dedicated himself to writing. In his later years, as his eyesight declined, he shifted to dictation, with his spoken words effortlessly flowing into eloquent chapters, culminating in the monumental The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun. The "literature" within The Complete Works extends beyond the fifth category, "Literary Collections," to encompass the sixth category ("Biographies"), the seventh category ("Diaries"), and the eighth category ("Letters"). In terms of literary genres, it spans poetry, prose (including essays, diaries, and letters), reportage, biography, and fiction, alongside sections defined specifically as "oral literature." These "ink-trails" (the traces of his written words) closely correspond to the "footsteps" of his global travels; only through both do we perceive the complete picture of Venerable Master Hsing Yun. From this, the profound importance of conducting a literary examination of his works becomes fully evident.

題目：
《人間福報》與星雲大師人間佛教的實踐
時間：10月6日 | 週二 10：00 - 12：00
講者：楊錦郁博士 | 美國花藝設計學院（AFAS）教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任

報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741295
演講簡介：
星雲大師一生以文字和語言弘揚佛法，從平面媒體用到電子媒體，跨域跨國，法水長流五大洲。2000年，他創辦《人間福報》，我那時任職聯合報副刊，奉報社之命專訪星雲大師談辦報緣起，文刊創刊當日聯副。其後兼《人間福報》藝文組主任，應聘擔任《人間福報》總監，於大師人間佛教的思想理念及其實踐，多所體會。此其間並長期為副刊撰寫專欄，結集5本散文專書。
Throughout his life, Venerable Master Hsing Yun propagated the Dharma through both the written and spoken word, utilizing mediums ranging from print to electronic media. His efforts crossed boundaries and transnational lines, spreading the water of the Dharma across five continents. In 2000, the Master founded The Merit Times. At that time, while working for the literary supplement of the United Daily News, I was commissioned by the newspaper to interview Venerable Master Hsing Yun regarding his vision for establishing the paper. The interview was published in the United Daily News literary supplement on the very day of The Merit Times’ inaugural issue. Later, I concurrently served as the Director of the Arts and Literature Section and was invited to become the Managing Director of The Merit Times, which granted me profound insights into the conceptual framework and practical application of the Master's Humanistic Buddhism. During this period, I also contributed long-running columns to the literary supplement, which were eventually compiled into five distinct prose volumes.
嘉賓簡介：
楊錦郁博士，散文家、媒體人，淡江大學中文系博士，美國花藝設計學院（AFAS）教授，曾任職聯合報副刊組、人間福報總監。著有多部人物報導集及散文集《遠方有光》、《穿過一樹的夜光》、《好時光》、《小西巷》、《霧中恆河》、《花希望成為自己的樣子》，論著《呂碧城文學與思想》等。曾獲中興文藝獎章、中山文藝創作獎，磺溪文學獎特別貢獻獎。

演講簡介：
星雲大師於1949年春率僧侶救護隊來臺，先到臺南，然後北上臺中、臺北，流離奔波，無處掛單，後落腳於中壢圓光寺，展開他在臺灣最初的艱困歲月，期間曾被逮捕拘禁，蒙難23天；曾赴苗栗法雲寺看守山林、到新竹靈隱寺協助臺灣青年佛教講習會，並開始執筆為文，參與佛教刊物的編輯工作，積累下一個階段在宜蘭弘法的文化資本。處境艱難，青年星雲法師如何肆應？
In the spring of 1949, Venerable Master Hsing Yun arrived in Taiwan leading the Buddhist Sangha Rescue Team. He initially traveled to Tainan, and later ventured north to Taichung and Taipei. Displaced, wandering, and finding no monastic shelter to lodge, he eventually settled at Yuanuang Temple in Zhongli, marking the beginning of his initial grueling years in Taiwan. During this turbulent period, he was arrested and detained, enduring 23 days of imprisonment.Later, he went to Fayun Temple in Miaoli to guard the mountain forests, and subsequently assisted with the Taiwan Youth Buddhist Seminar at Lingyin Temple in Hsinchu. It was also during this time that he began writing and participating in the editing of Buddhist periodicals, accumulation the cultural capital required for his next stage of Dharma propagation in Yilan. Given such severe and perilous circumstances, how did the young Venerable Master Hsing Yun adapt and respond?

題目：
星雲大師來臺初期的處境及其肆應
時間：10月5日 | 週一 14:30 - 16:30
講者：李瑞騰教授 | 中央大學中文系榮譽教授

演講簡介：
星雲大師於1949年春率僧侶救護隊來臺，先到臺南，然後北上臺中、臺北，流離奔波，無處掛單，後落腳於中壢圓光寺，展開他在臺灣最初的艱困歲月，期間曾被逮捕拘禁，蒙難23天；曾赴苗栗法雲寺看守山林、到新竹靈隱寺協助臺灣青年佛教講習會，並開始執筆為文，參與佛教刊物的編輯工作，積累下一個階段在宜蘭弘法的文化資本。處境艱難，青年星雲法師如何肆應？
In the spring of 1949, Venerable Master Hsing Yun arrived in Taiwan leading the Buddhist Sangha Rescue Team. He initially traveled to Tainan, and later ventured north to Taichung and Taipei. Displaced, wandering, and finding no monastic shelter to lodge, he eventually settled at Yuanuang Temple in Zhongli, marking the beginning of his initial grueling years in Taiwan. During this turbulent period, he was arrested and detained, enduring 23 days of imprisonment.Later, he went to Fayun Temple in Miaoli to guard the mountain forests, and subsequently assisted with the Taiwan Youth Buddhist Seminar at Lingyin Temple in Hsinchu. It was also during this time that he began writing and participating in the editing of Buddhist periodicals, accumulation the cultural capital required for his next stage of Dharma propagation in Yilan. Given such severe and perilous circumstances, how did the young Venerable Master Hsing Yun adapt and respond?

講者：蔡孟樺院長 | 佛光山人間佛教研究院副院長

演講簡介：
《星雲大師全集》高達395冊、逾四千萬字，不僅是當代人間佛教的百科全書，更是研究星雲大師文學世界最核心的文獻寶庫。本講座由《全集》主編的視角開啟，跳脫傳統學術理論的論述，從最微觀、最前線的編纂實務出發，希望與聽者一起重返大師創作的歷史現場，進入大師創作的初衷。在搜集與校勘過程中，編者得以穿梭時空，「近距離」凝視大師從青年詩歌小說到晚年口述隨筆的寫作身影。講座將分享親侍大師的微觀體感，透過筆觸細節讀出文字背後的呼吸與慈悲神情，為人間佛教文學研究開闢溫暖而深邃的新視野。
Spanning 395 volumes and over 40 million words, The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun serves not only as a contemporary encyclopedia of Humanistic Buddhism but also as the most critical archival treasure trove for studying the Master's literary world. Opening from the unique perspective of the Editor-in-Chief of The Complete Works, this lecture moves beyond traditional academic theories. Instead, it begins with the most micro-level and frontline practices of compilation, inviting the audience to return to the historical scenes of the Master’s creations and enter his original intent. Through the processes of collection and collation, the editor was able to traverse time and space, observing the Master’s writing style "at close range"—from his youthful poetry and novels to his oral dictations and essays in his later years. This lecture will share the speaker's personal experience of closely serving the Master. By examining subtle details in his writing, the lecture reads the breath and compassionate expressions behind the words, opening up a warm and profound new horizon for the study of Humanistic Buddhism literature.
嘉賓簡介：
蔡孟樺，資深佛教出版人，現任佛光山人間佛教研究院副院長、《人間佛教學報．藝文》主編。13歲皈依星雲大師，佛光山叢林學院畢業並於佛光大學文學研究所進修。歷任佛光山法堂書記、《人間福報》副刊主編與香海文化執行長，編輯出版大師著作百餘本，並主編《百年佛緣》、《獻給旅行者365日》、《人間佛教佛陀本懷》等。2016年銜師命擔綱《星雲大師全集》主編。長期致力於人間佛教思想的傳播與出版。

演講簡介：
本講座以田野調查視角，梳理人間佛教的跨國發展歷程。演講從 1990 年代佛光山遠赴歐洲弘法的歷史檔案切入，呈現在異質文化中建構華人社會支持網絡的過程；進而剖析道場如何透過跨宗教對話深耕西方世俗社會。隨後，視角轉回台灣本土的世界神明聯誼會，探討其跨越民間信仰界線的包容性實踐。最後，講座統合高雄佛陀紀念館的現代公共空間轉型，以及歐洲在地慈善賑濟與社會關懷，深入分析人間佛教如何以「慈善」為橋梁、以「公共性」為基石，在跨文化與跨制度的邊界上重構當代社會連結。
From the perspective of ethnographic fieldwork, this lecture traces the history of the transnational development of Humanistic Buddhism. Grounded in the historical archives of Fo Guang Shan’s missionary endeavors in Europe during the 1990s, the presentation illustrates the process of constructing Chinese social support networks within heterogeneous cultures. It further analyzes how Buddhist centers (dojos) deeply engage with Western secular societies through interfaith dialogue. Subsequently, the focus shifts back to Taiwan’s local phenomenon—the When Religious Bodies Meet (World Deity and Goddess Inter-Affiliation)—to explore its inclusive practices that cross the boundaries of folk religions. Finally, by integrating the transformation of the Fo Guang Shan Buddha Museum in Kaohsiung into a modern public space, alongside local charitable relief and social care in Europe, this lecture provides an in-depth analysis of how Humanistic Buddhism reconstructs contemporary social connections across intercultural and inter-institutional boundaries, utilizing "charity" as a bridge and "publicness" as a cornerstone.
嘉賓簡介：
陳登翔教授，德國法蘭克福大學社會學博士，現任南華大學宗教學研究所助理教授，兼任佛光山人間佛教研究院助理研究員。開設宗教社會學、人間佛教研究法、社會心理學等課程。

講者：陳登翔助理教授 | 南華大學宗教學研究所
主持人：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
ZOOM 網絡講座：每場講座皆開放ZOOM直播，無須報名！
請於演講時間直接登入：
會議 ID： 964 5779 7423  密碼： 999999
演講簡介：
本講座以田野調查視角，梳理人間佛教的跨國發展歷程。演講從 1990 年代佛光山遠赴歐洲弘法的歷史檔案切入，呈現在異質文化中建構華人社會支持網絡的過程；進而剖析道場如何透過跨宗教對話深耕西方世俗社會。隨後，視角轉回台灣本土的世界神明聯誼會，探討其跨越民間信仰界線的包容性實踐。最後，講座統合高雄佛陀紀念館的現代公共空間轉型，以及歐洲在地慈善賑濟與社會關懷，深入分析人間佛教如何以「慈善」為橋梁、以「公共性」為基石，在跨文化與跨制度的邊界上重構當代社會連結。
From the perspective of ethnographic fieldwork, this lecture traces the history of the transnational development of Humanistic Buddhism. Grounded in the historical archives of Fo Guang Shan’s missionary endeavors in Europe during the 1990s, the presentation illustrates the process of constructing Chinese social support networks within heterogeneous cultures. It further analyzes how Buddhist centers (dojos) deeply engage with Western secular societies through interfaith dialogue. Subsequently, the focus shifts back to Taiwan’s local phenomenon—the When Religious Bodies Meet (World Deity and Goddess Inter-Affiliation)—to explore its inclusive practices that cross the boundaries of folk religions. Finally, by integrating the transformation of the Fo Guang Shan Buddha Museum in Kaohsiung into a modern public space, alongside local charitable relief and social care in Europe, this lecture provides an in-depth analysis of how Humanistic Buddhism reconstructs contemporary social connections across intercultural and inter-institutional boundaries, utilizing "charity" as a bridge and "publicness" as a cornerstone.
嘉賓簡介：
陳登翔教授，德國法蘭克福大學社會學博士，現任南華大學宗教學研究所助理教授，兼任佛光山人間佛教研究院助理研究員。開設宗教社會學、人間佛教研究法、社會心理學等課程。

Topic: Mengzi on What People Really Want
Moderator: Prof. David Chai, Department of Philosophy, CUHK

Venue: Sir Run Run Shaw Hall, CUHK
(This lecture will be held at the College Bi-weekly Assembly)

Venue: Cho Yiu Conference Hall, G/F, University Administration Building, CUHK
(This lecture is jointly organized by New Asia College and Department of Philosophy, CUHK)
3rd Lecture

【Earn HK$50 CASH Each Time No Reward Cap】Join Our Urban Photo Collection Study 誠邀中大同學參與城市照片拍攝 ｜每份 HK$50 現金，多拍多得，總酬謝不設上限！   - Department of Geography and Resource Management
From: Gong Yu

yuGong@link.cuhk.edu.hk

誠邀參與城市照片拍攝研究
您好！我們現正進行一項關於城市環境的學術研究，旨在收集不同城市位置的照片，用於城市環境、影像分析及相關建模研究。
我們正在招募
• 年滿 18 歲
• 擁有可正常拍照的智能手機
您需要做什麼？
• 城市照片拍攝｜約 5 分鐘
按照拍攝指引，從
同一位置
分別拍攝
白天及夜晚
的城市照片。
• 上傳相關資訊｜約 3 分鐘
按照指引提交照片及相關資料。
參與酬謝
每份符合研究要求的有效提交可獲得
HK$50 CASH
。
現金酬謝，不是 Coupon / Voucher
可提交多個不同位置拍攝的照片
多拍多得，總酬謝不設上限
如何參與？
如有意參與此項研究，歡迎透過以下任何方式聯絡我們：
WhatsApp：69736364 / 95124618
WeChat：gyq125229
Email：
yuGong@link.cuhk.edu.hk
/
1155213466@link.cuhk.edu.hk
收到您的聯絡後，我們會向您提供詳細的拍攝方法及照片提交方式。
資料及私隱
您提供的所有資料將會保密處理，並僅供本研究使用。
歡迎將此訊息轉發給可能有興趣的人士。
感謝您的關注與支持！ 您的照片將有助於我們更好地了解香港的城市視覺環境。
Participants Wanted for an Urban Photo Collection Study
We are conducting an academic study on urban environments. The study aims to collect real-world images from different urban locations for research on urban environments, image analysis, and related modelling methods.
Who can participate?
• Aged 18 or above
• Have a smartphone capable of taking photos
What will you do?
• Take urban photos | Approx. 5 minutes
Following the photo-taking instructions, take both
daytime and nighttime
city-view photos
from the same location
.
• Upload the photos and related information | Approx. 3 minutes
Submit the photos together with the requested supporting information.
