(See the English version after the Chinese version)
►
觀看博物館大使影片
◄
2026/27年度
賽馬會氣候變化博物館大使計劃
（上學期）現正接受申請。
賽馬會氣候變化博物館
誠邀所有中大全日制學生報名，一起推動氣候行動。
賽馬會氣候變化博物館大使
與博物館教育活動和日常運作息息相關，更是未來在社會推動可持續發展的領袖。入選的學生將會接受培訓，參與博物館的日常運作，例如接待訪客和帶領導賞團等，亦有機會協助籌辦博物館活動，如工作坊和外展教育活動。
此外，你亦
：
可以獲得免費培訓及專業發展；
有機會獲得旅費資助，出席COP31及其他國際會議；
有機會接受電台及其他媒體的訪問。
如果你：
就讀中大全日制課程（任何學科）；
享受與不同年齡和背景的人交流，並希望加強溝通和交流技巧；
期望擁有充實的大學生活和豐富的履歷表；或
希望為地球出一分力，倡導和推動氣候行動，
請即填妥
網上報名表
，成為我們的一分子！
截止報名日期：2026年9月23日（星期三）晚上11時59分
計劃詳情：
https://www.mocc.cuhk.edu.hk/mocc-ambassadorship
如有查詢，請致電3943 0817或電郵至
jaysonchan@cuhk.edu.hk
與陳先生聯絡。
►
Watch the MoCC Ambassadorship Video
◄
Applications for the 1st-semester cohort of the MoCC Ambassadorship 2026/27 are now open.  All full-time students of CUHK, regardless of academic background(s), are eligible to apply for promoting climate action.
MoCC Ambassadors are an integral part of the education and operations of the
Jockey Club Museum of Climate Change
(MoCC), and they are the future sustainability leaders of the society.  Selected students are given effective and engaging training and all-rounded service-learning opportunities.  For example, they will guide visitors on MoCC tours, assist in the MoCC’s outreach activities, workshops and climate education projects.
As an ambassador, you will also:
Receive free training and professional development;
Have the opportunity to receive a travel grant to attend COP31 and other international conferences;
Have the opportunity to be interviewed by radio and other media outlets.
Join us if you:
are a full-time CUHK student;
enjoy interacting with diverse audiences, from kindergarten children to senior citizens, and wish to develop your interpersonal and communication skills;
look forward to enriching your university experience and enhancing your CV; or
are committed to climate leadership and action.
Deadline: 11:59 pm, 23 September 2026 (Wednesday)
Online application
and details:
https://www.mocc.cuhk.edu.hk/mocc-ambassadorship
You are welcome to contact Mr Jayson Chan at 3943 0817 or
jaysonchan@cuhk.edu.hk
if you have any questions.

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Hello! We cordially invite
CUHK undergraduate students (must be Hong Kong permanent residents)
to participate in an online research study regarding organ donation intentions.
參與流程與重要說明：
為了確保研究數據的質量與您的填寫體驗，請務必閱讀以下細則：
設備建議：
為保證填寫的便利性與數據質量，
強烈建議使用電腦
完成本研究。
實驗組成：
本研究包含
兩個部分
。參與者必須完成全部兩個部分才能獲得現金補償。
特別注意：
完成第一部分後，需
間隔
24
小時
方可進行第二部分，請您預留充分的時間。
完成實驗總時長約為
30-40
分鐘

實驗系統設有篩選機制。如果在實驗過程中彈出「您無法參與本實驗」的提示，則證明您未通過篩選或喪失資格，屆時將無法獲得補償。
知情同意：
在填寫問卷前，您需要簽署一份知情同意書 。
Participation Process & Important Notes:
To ensure the quality of research data and a smooth experience, please read the following details carefully:
Device Recommendation:
To ensure ease of completion and data quality, it is
strongly recommended to use a computer
to complete this study.
Study Structure:
This study consists of
two parts
. Participants must complete both parts to be eligible for cash compensation.
Special Note:
There is a mandatory
24-hour interval
between the first and second parts. Please set aside sufficient time.
Total Duration:
The total time to complete the study is approximately
30-40 minutes
.
Participation Eligibility:
The system includes a screening mechanism. If a message stating
"You are not able to participant this study"
pops up during the process, it indicates that you have not passed the screening or have lost eligibility, and no compensation will be provided.

Before starting the questionnaire, you will be required to sign an
informed consent form
.

Upon completing both stages of the experiment, you will receive
HKD 100 in cash
as monetary compensation.
Note: If you have already participated in this experiment, please do not sign up again. Duplicate registrations will be considered invalid.

持有香港永久居民身份的香港中文大學在讀本科生 。

bodyText:

Announcements
Student Helper Recruitment 學生助理招募 - Curriculum and Instruction
From: Zhoutiao LI
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
zhoutiaoli@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Support University Research on Student Well-being & Resilience
We are recruiting
Student Helpers
to support two university research projects focusing on
student well-being, resilience, and university experiences
.
As a Student Helper, you will assist the research team in collecting questionnaire responses from university students and contribute to meaningful academic research.
Your Responsibilities
You will:
Invite eligible students to participate in online surveys
Share survey invitations through your student networks
Encourage students to complete questionnaires and collect valid responses
Who Can Apply?
We welcome:
CUHK undergraduate students
CUHK postgraduate students
Students with good communication skills and access to student networks
No previous research experience is required.
Reward

HK$20 for every valid response collected
Example:
40 valid responses = HK$800 reward
There is
no upper limit
. The more valid responses you help collect, the more you can earn.
Certificate Recognition
Students who successfully collect
40+ valid responses
will receive:

Official Certificate of Academic Research Participation
Why Join?
By joining as a Student Helper, you can:
⭐ Gain experience in university research and data collection
⭐ Develop communication and organizational skills
⭐ Strengthen your CV with research experience
⭐ Contribute to improving student support and university education

Interested students are welcome to apply now.
支援大學研究，累積研究經驗
我們現正招募
Student Helpers
（學生助理），協助兩項關於學生身心健康、抗逆力及大學學習經歷的大學研究項目。
作為 Student Helper，你將協助研究團隊收集學生問卷數據，參與具意義的大學研究，並了解實際學術研究及資料收集流程。
工作內容
你將協助：
邀請合資格學生參與網上問卷調查
通過個人學生網絡分享研究邀請
鼓勵學生完成問卷，並收集有效數據
申請資格
歡迎以下同學申請：
香港中文大學本科生（優先考慮）
香港中文大學研究生
具備良好溝通能力及學生網絡
對教育、心理學、學生發展或研究工作有興趣的同學
無需相關研究經驗。
研究貢獻獎勵
每份有效問卷可獲 HK$20 獎勵
例如：
40 份有效問卷 = HK$800 獎勵
沒有最高限制。協助收集越多有效問卷，獲得的獎勵越多。
證書認可
成功收集
40
份或以上有效問卷
的學生，將獲頒：
學術研究參與證書
以表彰你對大學研究的貢獻。
參與價值
加入 Student Helper 團隊，你可以：
⭐ 累積大學研究及數據收集經驗
⭐ 提升溝通及組織能力
⭐ 豐富個人履歷
⭐ 參與改善學生支持及大學教育的重要研究
有興趣參與的同學，歡迎立即申請。
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

From: Reimagining Yung Shue Au
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ysa-cuhk@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
「重塑榕樹凹：共創山海村落」—
地方營造大使招募
中文大學建築學院現正推動一項以「鄉郊地方營造（Rural Placemaking）」為核心的鄉村學堂及暑期工作坊，誠邀熱愛香港鄉郊文化、樂於親身參與實作的你，一同走進榕樹凹，參與村落景觀的復育與共創行動。
計劃期間，我們將邀請香港建造學院團隊擔任導師，帶領參加者學習傳統建造工藝及鄉郊實踐技術。參加者可自選出席一天或多天工作坊。若完成九天的工作坊後，參加者將獲頒由中文大學建築學院及香港建造學院簽發之服務證書，以作嘉許。
榕樹凹介紹：
榕樹凹位於新界東北端，於三百多年前開基立村，是一條歷史悠久的客家溫姓村落，村落鼎盛時期曾有逾三百名居民。由於地理位置接近邊境，榕樹凹在1980年代曾設有英軍軍營，留下了一段獨特而鮮為人知的歷史印記。雖然村落現已無人居住，但村民近年積極推動復村工作，透過修復祖屋、整理村史、舉辦村宴及傳統儀式，如籌辦麒麟隊；重建社群連結與文化記憶，展現出對深厚的鄉土感情與文化傳承精神。
****************************************
願景
共創鄉郊地方營造：以低碳修復與地方記憶，重塑山海景觀。
空間實作：以小型建設改善路徑與休憩空間。
感官敘事：將歷史轉化為具體的景觀導覽。
​共創行動：透過行動連結設計思考與鄉村振興。
****************************************
活動地點： 新界沙頭角榕樹凹村
****************************************
工作坊形式及階段:
鄉村導賞：認識榕樹凹村落歷史，了解鄉郊地方營造與文化地景。
物資收集：在山海與村落之間收集可用材料。
景觀實踐*：進行場地清理及空間建設實作，由香港建造學院導師帶領鄉村學堂，教授鄉郊景觀實踐技藝與傳統建造方法。
（ *
代表當日將由建造學院導師帶領鄉村學堂及景觀實踐活動。）
9
月
8日（二）、15日（二）、16日（三）*、17日（四）*、22日（二）
實際工作坊日期將視乎報名人數、天氣及工作人員情況作適當調整，包括增加或減少工作坊次數，屈時會通知相關參加者及在宣傳平台上公布。
- 參加者可因應自身時間安排，選擇參與單日或多日工作坊。
- 請參加者選擇所有可出席日期，以便主辦單位安排及分組。
- 導賞活動日期將稍後公布，會安排在平日和假日或工作坊期間舉行。
- 實際工作坊日期將視乎報名人數、天氣及現場情況作適當調整，並另行通知相關參加者。
- 如出席一節鄉村導賞、八節工作坊可獲中大建築學院及香港建造學院之義工服務證書。
*************************************
活動時間：早上 09:00 至 下午 04:00
名額：每節12人。
*************************************
對象：
* 身體狀況良好，能應付長時間戶外活動人士
* 對建築、景觀設計、保育等感興趣的人士
****************************************
報名連結：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733829
- 如出席一節鄉村導賞、八日工作坊可獲中大建築學院及香港建造學院之義工服務證書。
****************************************
計劃名稱：
「重塑榕樹凹故事：透過實驗式社區場地及自然文化徑共創鄉郊地方營造」
合辦機構：
中文大學建築學院
香港建造學院
榕樹凹村
資助：
環境及生態局環境科 鄉郊保育辦公室「鄉郊保育資助計劃」
****************************************
備註：
1. 榕樹凹屬禁區範圍，參加者需預先申請禁區許可證方可前往。
2. 在項目進行期間，所有與工作坊相關的船程費用將由計劃負責安排及資助。參加者需要自行安排陸路交通，並準備足夠食物（午餐）和飲用水。
3. 工作坊將以粵語進行。
4. 工作坊內容或會因天氣、路況、項目進度，以及參加者或工作人員身體狀況而作臨時調整，恕不另行通知，敬請留意。
5. 工作坊涉及一定體力勞動及長時間戶外活動。如參加者有身體不適、舊患或其他健康狀況，請預先通知主辦單位。
6. 村內沒有士多或補給設施，請預先準備足夠飲用水、午餐、乾糧、防曬及防蚊用品，並按個人需要攜帶雨具。
7. 工作坊地點蚊蟲較多，建議穿著淺色長袖衣物及長褲，並按需要攜帶蚊怕水。
8. 工作坊已包括基本第三者責任保險，參加者可按需要自行購買其他保險。
9. 鄉郊地區路面或有高低不平、濕滑、碎石情況，參加者須小心步行。
10. 如參加者未有遵守安全指引或工作人員安排，主辦單位有權終止其參與工作坊。
11. 活動期間我們可能會拍攝或／及錄影以作記錄、報告、宣傳及推廣用途。如你不欲被攝入鏡，請在活動開始前告知工作人員，以便我們作出適當安排。
12. 如有查詢，請電郵至
ysa-cuhk@cuhk.edu.hk
或致電 3943 6520 /3943 6518.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
“Reimagining Yung Shue Au: Co-creating a Mountain-Sea Village”
— Recruitment for Rural-placemaking Ambassadors
Re-telling the Yung Shue Au Story: Co-creating Rural Place
The School of Architecture at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently organising a rural school and summer workshop centred on the concept of
rural placemaking
. We invite individuals who are passionate about Hong Kong’s rural culture and interested in hands-on practice to join us in Yung Shue Au and participate in the revitalisation and co-creation of the village landscape.
During the programme, instructors from the Hong Kong Institute of Construction will lead participants in learning traditional construction crafts and rural practical skills. Participants may choose to attend one or multiple workshop sessions according to their availability. Those who complete nine workshop days will receive a service certificate jointly issued by the School of Architecture, CUHK and the Hong Kong Institute of Construction in recognition of their participation and contribution.
Introduction to Yung Shue Au
Located in the northeastern New Territories, Yung Shue Au is a historic Hakka village established over 300 years ago by the Wan clan. At its peak, the village was home to more than 300 residents. Owing to its proximity to the border, a British military camp was stationed in the village during the 1980s, leaving behind a unique yet little-known historical legacy.
Although the village is currently uninhabited, villagers have actively promoted village revitalisation in recent years through repairing ancestral houses, documenting village history, organising village banquets and traditional rituals, as well as reviving the Qilin dance team. These efforts reflect a deep attachment to the village and a strong commitment to cultural inheritance and community reconnection.
Vision
Co-creating Rural Placemaking
Reimagining the mountain-sea landscape through low-carbon restoration and local memories.
Spatial Practice
Improving pathways and communal resting spaces through small-scale construction.
Sensory Narratives
Transforming local history into tangible landscape interpretation experiences.
Collective Action
Connecting design thinking with rural revitalisation through practical engagement.
Venue:
Yung Shue Au, Sha Tau Kok, New Territories
Programme Format and Phases
Village Guided Tour
Understanding the history of Yung Shue Au and learning about rural placemaking and cultural landscapes.
Material Collection
Collecting usable materials from the surrounding mountain, coastal, and village environment.
Landscape Practice
Participating in site clearing and spatial construction workshops led by instructors from the Hong Kong Institute of Construction, focusing on rural landscape practices and traditional building techniques.
(* Stars indicate days when Hong Kong Institute of Construction instructors will lead the Landscape workshop.)
September
8 September (Tue), 15 September (Tue), 16 September (Wed)*, 17 September (Thur)*, 22 September (Tue)
Please note that actual workshop dates are subject to adjustment based on enrollment numbers, weather conditions, and staff availability. This includes the potential to increase or decrease the number of sessions. Registered participants will be notified directly of any changes, and updates will be posted across our promotional platforms.
- Participants may choose to join single-day or multiple-day workshops according to their availability.
​- Participants are encouraged to select all available dates to facilitate scheduling and grouping arrangements.
- Indicates dates on which the landscape practice workshops will be led by instructors from the Hong Kong Institute of Construction.
- Dates for the guided tours will be announced later and will be arranged on both weekdays and weekends.
- Actual workshop dates may be adjusted according to registration numbers, weather conditions, and site situations. Relevant participants will be notified separately.
Workshop Time
09:00 am – 04:00 pm
Capacity
12 participants per session
Target Participants
Individuals in good physical condition who are able to participate in long hours of outdoor activities
Individuals interested in architecture, landscape design, conservation, and related fields
Registration Link
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733829
Participants who attend one village guided tour and eight workshop sessions will receive a volunteer service certificate jointly issued by the School of Architecture, CUHK and the Hong Kong Institute of Construction.
Project Title
“Re-telling the Yung Shue Au Story: Co-creating Rural Place with Experimental Communal Hub and Eco-Cultural Trail”
Organisers
School of Architecture, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong Institute of Construction
Yung Shue Au Village
Funding Support
Countryside Conservation Office
Environment Branch, Environment and Ecology Bureau
Countryside Conservation Funding Scheme
Remarks
1. Yung Shue Au is located within a restricted area. Participants are required to apply for a Closed Area Permit in advance.
2. During the project period, all boat transportation costs related to the workshops will be arranged and subsidised by the project. Participants are responsible for their own land transportation and should prepare sufficient food and drinking water.
3. The workshops will be conducted in Cantonese.
4. Workshop arrangements may be adjusted due to weather, road conditions, project progress, or the physical conditions of participants and staff without prior notice.
5. The workshops involve physical labour and extended outdoor activities. Participants with health conditions, previous injuries, or physical discomfort are advised to inform the organisers in advance.
6. There are no shops or supply facilities in the village. Participants should prepare sufficient drinking water, sun protection, mosquito repellent, and rain gear if necessary.
7. Mosquitoes and insects are common at the workshop site. Participants are advised to wear light-coloured long-sleeved clothing and long trousers, and bring insect repellent if needed.
8. Basic third-party liability insurance is included. Participants may arrange additional insurance at their own discretion.
9. Rural paths may be uneven, slippery, or covered with loose gravel. Participants should walk carefully.
10. The organisers reserve the right to terminate participation if safety instructions or staff arrangements are not followed.
11. Photographs and/or video recordings may be taken during the activities for documentation, reporting, publicity, and promotional purposes. Participants who do not wish to appear in photographs or recordings should inform staff before the activity begins.
12. For enquiries, please contact
ysa-cuhk@cuhk.edu.hk
or call 3943 6520 / 3943 6518.

Recruitment of participants aged 6-80 years old with LONG COVID 誠邀 6-80 歲有長新冠症狀的患者參加「中醫/西醫治療長新冠症狀」的研究 - Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine
From: Wendy LI

hkiimresearch@cuhk.edu.hk

香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正進行一項為期8周，以內服中藥(沖劑)或西藥改善長新冠患者症狀的臨床研究，以下是研究安排：
研究對象：
年齡介乎6至80歲；
願意接受中醫或西醫治療4星期；
每星期一次覆診跟進病程；
目的         : 比較中藥與西藥對治療長新冠患者在改善生活質量、臨床症狀和生活社等治療效果和安全性。
研究內容：中/西醫評估*、問卷評估、抽血檢查、服用中藥或西藥等。
*注意: 本研究會隨機分「中藥組」或「西藥組」
研究地點： (a)中藥組: 沙田威爾斯親王醫院; (b)西藥組: 指定西醫診所 (中環)。
參與方式： 若有興趣，歡迎
1.透過以下方式報名：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13670048
2.亦歡迎您致電或WhatsApp我們6082-2583/ 2873-3245了解詳情。
Research Introduction:
The novel coronavirus has caused a global pandemic since the end of 2019. People are increasingly paying attention to the long-term effects of COVID-19 infection.People whose symptoms last for more than four weeks after COVID-19 infection are called [Long COVID]. The main symptoms include severe fatigue, shortness of breath, heart damage (such as myocarditis), cognitive impairment, sleep disorders, post-traumatic stress disorder syndrome, Muscle pain, decreased concentration, headache, impaired taste and smell, etc. affect the respiratory system, cardiovascular system, digestive system, urinary system, immune system, etc.
The Hong Kong Institute of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine at the Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently conducting an 8-week clinical study on the improvement of symptoms of patients with COVID-19 by taking Chinese medicine (infusion) or Western medicine.
Target
: Age 6-80 who have recovered from COVID-19 infection.
Purpose
: To compare the therapeutic effects and safety of traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine on improving the quality of life, clinical symptoms and social functions of long-term COVID-19 patients.
Research Content
: Visits, questionnaire assessment, blood draw before and after taking medicine,taking research Chinese medicine or Western medicine, etc.
Study Location
:(a) Chinese medicine group: Prince of Wales Hospital, Shatin;
(b) Western medicine group: designated western medicine clinic.
Participation
： Free of charge. If interested, please
1. sign up through the following ：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13670048
2. You are also welcome to call or WhatsApp us at 6082-2583/ 2873-3245 for details.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/

**This study is supervised by Prof. Karim Bettache (email: karimbettache@cuhk.edu.hk)**
Dear Potential Participants,
We are a research team from the School of Governance and Policy Science at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. This study is funded by the Research Grants Council (RGC) and led by a leading scholar in political psychology. The findings are expected to be published in top-tier international journals.
We sincerely invite South Asian permanent residents of Hong Kong (e.g., Indian, Pakistani, Nepalese, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan, etc.) to participate in a focus group interview on the long-term psychological impact of colonialism on post-colonial societies.
Target participants:
South Asian ethnicity (e.g., Indian, Pakistani, Nepalese, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan, etc.)
Holders of Hong Kong Permanent Resident status
Able to communicate in Mandarin, Cantonese, or English
Procedures and details of this study:
Research Consent
Focus Group Interview: A group discussion led by professional researchers, lasting approximately 1.5 hours
Flexible Location: In-person at CUHK campus or online participation available
A $100 HKD token of appreciation will be provided upon completion. All personal information and discussion content will be kept strictly confidential and used for academic research purposes only.
Participation is voluntary, and your responses will be kept confidential.
If you are interested in participating, please contact us via:
WeChat: 13809899482
WhatsApp: 69409544
Email: 1155220689@link.cuhk.edu.hk
We will contact you afterwards to arrange further details.
For inquiries, please feel free to reach out through the above channels.
**本研究由Prof. Karim Bettache監督（電郵：karimbettache@cuhk.edu.hk)**
您好，我們是香港中文大學政務與政策科學學院的研究團隊。本研究由香港研究資助局（RGC）資助，PI為政治心理學領域泰斗級學者，最終成果擬發表於國際頂級期刊。
本研究團隊誠邀南亞裔香港永久居民參與一項焦點小組訪談，旨在探討殖民主義對前殖民地社會心理的長期影響。
研究對象：
南亞裔人士（如印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊爾、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡等裔）
持有香港永久居民身份
能以普通話 / 廣東話 / 英文進行溝通
以下為是次研究需要完成的事項：
簽署參加同意書
參與焦點小組訪談：在專業研究人員帶領下進行小組討論，時長約1.5小時
地點靈活：可選擇香港中文大學校內面談，或透過線上平台參與
完成研究後，參加者可獲得$100港幣酬謝。訪談內容將全程嚴格保密，所有個人信息及對話內容僅用於學術研究用途。
本研究屬自願參與性質，期間所取得的資料都會被嚴格保密。
如有意參與此項研究，歡迎透過以下方式聯絡我們：
微信：13809899482
WhatsApp：69409544
Email: 1155220689@link.cuhk.edu.hk
收到聯絡後，我們會再與合適參加者溝通後續安排。
如果對研究細節有任何疑問，歡迎透過上述方式與我們聯絡。

bodyText:

Announcements
Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!!] !!!注意: 男性特定群組 HPV 病毒篩查   [費用全免] [$400交通津貼] - Department of Surgery
From: Tim Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學泌尿外科研究招募
:
香港中文大學泌尿外科現正進行一項男性特定群體的尿液及生物樣本HPV和病例對照研究。人類乳頭瘤病毒（HPV） 是全球最常見的性傳染病毒之一，能影響男性並導致多種疾病，包括生殖器疣（椰菜花）、陰莖癌、肛門癌 及 口咽癌。然而，男性 HPV 的感染情況一直缺乏研究，而你的參與將有助填補這個重要的知識空白。
本研究旨在了解HPV感染率、患者人口統計特徵、臨床特徵以及被診斷患有HPV相關惡性腫瘤的男性患者的疾病負擔。以評估男性尿液 HPV 測試的準確性，並更深入了解男性感染 HPV的風險因素，以及幫助未來預防及治療策略。
-如初步檢測確診為HPV陽性的患者，或將安排進一步行檢查 (例如:軟式膀胱鏡檢查等等)及跟進複檢。
參加者條件（男性，18歲或以上）：

The Chinese University of Hong Kong Division of Urology Research Recruitment
The Department of Surgery (Urology), The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently recruiting participants for a hybrid cohort and case-control study on male urinary HPV.
Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted viruses worldwide. It can affect men and lead to serious conditions including genital warts, penile cancer, anal cancer, and oropharyngeal cancer. However, HPV infection in men remains under-studied. Your cooperation is highly solicited.

[HKD 300 Cash Participation Payment] Participants Wanted for a 90-Minute Online Visual Study 【港幣300元現金參與報酬】誠邀參與90分鐘網上視覺研究 - Department of Psychology
From: Ng Tin Yan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
jaidellosaariza@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
We are recruiting adults aged 18 or above for a 90-minute online study on visual perception and judgement. The study includes two computer-based visual tasks and a set of questionnaires containing 115 questions. Participants must have normal or corrected-to-normal vision and use a desktop or laptop computer with a physical keyboard. One of the questionnaires is available in English only. Detailed instructions, practice trials and rest breaks will be provided. Participants who complete the study will receive HKD 300 as a cash participation payment.
現正招募年滿18歲人士參與一項約90分鐘的網上視覺知覺及判斷研究。研究包括兩項電腦視覺任務及一套合共115題的問卷。參加者須視力正常或經矯正後正常，並使用配備實體鍵盤的桌上電腦或手提電腦。其中一份問卷只提供英文版本。研究會提供詳細說明、練習及休息時間。完成整項研究的參加者將獲得港幣300元現金參與報酬。
Please use Google Chrome to open the study link below. Safari is not supported.
請使用 Google Chrome 開啟以下研究連結；Safari 瀏覽器不支援本研究。
Study link / 研究連結：
https://app.open-lab.online/studies/5VEDX
This study is part of a collaborative project between Dr. Ng Tin Yan (Hezul), Department of Psychology, Lingnan University, and Prof. Urs Maurer, Department of Psychology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
本研究是嶺南大學心理學系 Ng Tin Yan 博士（Hezul）與香港中文大學心理學系 Urs Maurer 教授合作研究項目的一部分。
Project / 研究項目：
Neural Signatures of Excitation-Inhibition Balance in the Heterogeneity of Autistic Traits
Contact / 查詢：
Dr. Ng Tin Yan /
hezulng@ln.edu.hk

[Join Now] Climate Action at CUHK: Empowering Youth Climate Advocates Workshop  「氣候行動在中大：培育青年氣候倡議者」工作坊 - Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development Office
From: Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development Office

COP31將至，如果你想了解更多有關聯合國氣候變化大會（COP），以及全球氣候談判如何推動氣候行動，歡迎報名參加是次工作坊
低碳想創坊項目經理黎曉樺女士（Kylie Lai）將擔任講者，帶領參加者深入認識COP及《聯合國氣候變化框架公約》（UNFCCC），探討重要氣候議題，並了解青年在推動氣候行動中的角色。歡迎所有中大學生參與
日期：2026年9月16日（星期三）
⏰ 時間：16:30–18:00
地點：康本國際學術園 411室
語言：粵語
ℹ 詳情及報名：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13738617
了解更多COP31中大學生參與計劃︰
https://www.instagram.com/p/DbpNCeOCFB1/
如有任何疑問，請聯絡社會責任及可持續發展處（
srsdo@cuhk.edu.hk
）。
COP31 is coming this November! If you are curious about what the Conference of the Parties (COP) is and how global climate negotiations work, don't miss this opportunity to learn more
In this workshop, Ms Kylie Lai from CarbonCare InnoLab will introduce COP and the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), explore key climate issues, and discuss how young people can contribute to meaningful climate action. All CUHK students are welcome
Date: 16 September 2026 (Wednesday)
⏰ Time: 16:30–18:00
Venue: Yasumoto International Academic Park 411
Language: Cantonese
ℹ Details and Registration:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13738617
Learn more about ‘CUHK Student Participation at COP31’:
https://www.instagram.com/p/DbpNCeOCFB1/

srsdo@cuhk.edu.hk
).

bodyText:

2026/09/04

Announcements
創博館知識轉移學生大使 Inno-Ambassadors招募中‼KTO InnoPort is hiring Inno-Ambassadors now‼  - KTO InnoPort
From: KTO InnoPort
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
innoport@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
知識轉移學生大使 Inno-Ambassador招募中‼
熱愛創作，鍾意寫文章，又或者識得剪Reels、拍片？不如將呢啲技能變成實戰經驗，仲可以同一班熱愛創新創業的中大人一齊做嘢！
中大創博館 InnoPort 現正招募Inno-Ambassador，有兩大工作方向俾你揀：
影片創作
文字創作
你可以：
同中大教授、校友、初創團隊做訪問，寫文章
拍故事、剪 Reels、製作活動影片
走入校園不同角落，認識多元社會議題，將創新點子帶出校園
適合邊啲同學？
中大全日制學士／碩士 (任何學系) ，對創新、創業及知識轉移有濃厚興趣
鍾意寫嘢、拍片剪片、玩 social media
熟悉影片拍攝及剪接軟件 (如 Adobe Premiere、After Effects、Photoshop、Illustrator 等）
具拍攝、剪片或社交平台影片創作經驗者優先，需提供過往作品連結／示例
有興趣加入我哋？立即send你嘅CV同Portfolio去innoport@cuhk.edu.hk 喇！
亦可填寫以下表格：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13701570
 KTO InnoPort Inno-Ambassador Recruitment Is Now Open‼
Love creating content, enjoy writing articles, or know how to edit Reels and shoot videos? Turn those skills into real-world experience—and work alongside a group of CUHK students who are passionate about innovation and entrepreneurship!
CUHK InnoPort is now recruiting Inno-Ambassadors, with two main tracks to choose from:
Video Creation
Writing Creation
You will be able to:
Interview CUHK professors, alumni, and startup teams, and write articles
Shoot stories, edit Reels, and produce event videos
Explore different corners of campus, learn about diverse social issues, and bring innovative ideas beyond the university
Who is this for?
Full-time CUHK undergraduate / postgraduate students from any discipline who have a strong interest in innovation, entrepreneurship, and knowledge transfer.
Students who enjoy writing, filming, video editing, and using social media
Students familiar with video shooting and editing software such as Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
Students with video production, editing, or social media content creation experience are preferred. Please provide links or samples of your previous work.
Interested in joining us? Send your CV and portfolio to
innoport@cuhk.edu.hk
or fill in the application form
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13701570
now!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

title: Are you the next CUHK Outstanding Student? Apply now for 2026!!!! 香港中文大學傑出學生獎2026－現正接受報名！！！！
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/04
»
Events / Activities
Are you the next CUHK Outstanding Student? Apply now for 2026!!!! 香港中文大學傑出學生獎2026－現正接受報名！！！！ - Office of Student Affairs
From: Office of Student Affairs
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
osa@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大
學
傑出學生獎
2026－現正接受報名！
你是否曾在藝術、創新、體育或社會服務方面發揮所長，創造影響力？
歡迎申請
2026 傑出學生獎，與大家分享你的成就和故事！
除了追求學術成就外，香港中文大學(中大)學生亦積極在非學術範疇發揮所長。為表揚在不同領域有傑出表現，並持續為大學社群及社會作出積極貢獻的學生，中大設立「傑出學生獎」，以肯定其成就與貢獻，並鼓勵同學追求卓越、勇於突破自我。
【獎項類別】
藝術
創新與發明
社會服務
體育
特別表現
【申請資格】
在2025–26學年就讀於香港中文大學的全日制本科生或研究生，如於有關學年在上述其中一個範疇取得卓越成就或作出重大貢獻，均符合申請資格。
【截止日期】
2026年9月18日（星期五）中午12時正。
歡迎以個人或團隊形式申請。
【詳情及報名】
https://www.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/osa-application-guideline/
【查詢】
潘小姐(電話：3943 7210；電郵：
gladys@cuhk.edu.hk
)或
陳小姐(電話：3943 1843；電郵：
kimichan@cuhk.edu.hk
)。
誠邀你把握機會展示卓越成就，分享成長歷程，並以自身經驗啟發同儕。
我們期待收到你的報名！
Are you the next CUHK Outstanding Student?
Apply now for 2026!
Have you made a mark in the arts, innovation, sports, or social service this year? It’s time to be recognized for your passion and achievements!
The CUHK Outstanding Students Awards 2026 aim to celebrate students who have demonstrated outstanding achievements and made a positive impact on the University community and society through their dedication, talent, and perseverance.
【
Award Categories
】
Arts
Innovation and Invention
Social Service
Sports
Special Achievement
【Eligibility】
Full-time undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled at CUHK during the 2025–26 academic year who have demonstrated outstanding achievements or made significant contributions in one of the above categories within the same academic year are eligible to apply.
【
Application Deadline
】
18 September 2026 (Friday), 12:00 noon
.
(Applications are welcome from both individuals and teams.)
【
Details & Application
】
https://www.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/osa-application-guideline/
【
Enquiries
】
Ms. Gladys Poon (Tel: 3943 7210 | Email:
gladys@cuhk.edu.hk
)
Ms. Kimi Chan (Tel: 3943 1843 | Email:
kimichan@cuhk.edu.hk
)
We cordially invite you to seize this opportunity to present your remarkable achievements, share your journey, and inspire your peers with your experience.
We look forward to receiving your application!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Have you made a mark in the arts, innovation, sports, or social service this year? It’s time to be recognized for your passion and achievements!
The CUHK Outstanding Students Awards 2026 aim to celebrate students who have demonstrated outstanding achievements and made a positive impact on the University community and society through their dedication, talent, and perseverance.
【
Award Categories
】
Arts
Innovation and Invention
Social Service
Sports
Special Achievement
【Eligibility】
Full-time undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled at CUHK during the 2025–26 academic year who have demonstrated outstanding achievements or made significant contributions in one of the above categories within the same academic year are eligible to apply.
【
Application Deadline
】
18 September 2026 (Friday), 12:00 noon
.
(Applications are welcome from both individuals and teams.)
【
Details & Application
】
https://www.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/osa-application-guideline/
【
Enquiries
】
Ms. Gladys Poon (Tel: 3943 7210 | Email:
gladys@cuhk.edu.hk
)
Ms. Kimi Chan (Tel: 3943 1843 | Email:
kimichan@cuhk.edu.hk
)
We cordially invite you to seize this opportunity to present your remarkable achievements, share your journey, and inspire your peers with your experience.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Research Paper CompetitionLingnan Culture Studies Research Paper Competition 2026-27 論文獎「嶺南文化研究論文獎」2026-27 - Institute of Chinese Studies
From: Joanne HUI
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ics-lingnan@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[The English version follows the Chinese one.]
嶺南文化研究計劃「嶺南文化研究論文獎」
2026-27
「嶺南文化研究論文獎」旨在推動國際嶺南文化學術研究，以鼓勵海內外在讀博士生及青年研究員在嶺南文化領域進行深入研究。
參獎資格：
本論文獎接受在讀博士生及青年研究員提交嶺南文化研究領域的優秀論文。論文內容可與古今文學、歷史、哲學、宗教、藝術、語言學、人類學等範疇相關。論文必須從未發表或出版，字數在三萬以內，中、英文皆可。
注意事項：
提交日期：2026年8月1日至2026年12月31日
參獎者須填妥申請表，並連同論文以電郵附件方式一併發送至：
ics-lingnan@cuhk.edu.hk
，郵件標題為「嶺南文化研究論文獎2026-27（申請人全名）」。
報名表格
：
按此
查　　詢：
地　　址: 香港沙田香港中文大學中國文化研究所105室
電　　話: (852) 3943 7393
傳　　真: (852) 2603 5149
電　　郵:
ics-lingnan@cuhk.edu.hk
Lingnan Culture Studies Research Paper Competition 2026-27
Organized by the Research Programme for Lingnan Culture, Institute of Chinese Studies, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
The Competition aims to promote international academic research on Lingnan culture, as well as to encourage local and overseas doctoral students and young research fellows who are aspiring to conduct in-depth research in the field.
Eligibility:
1. Eligibility is limited to doctoral students and young research fellows.
2. Submissions must be papers of original research on Lingnan culture, in the areas of literature, history, philosophy, religion, arts, linguistics, anthropology, or other humanities disciplines.
3. Submission papers should be either in Chinese or English of no more than 30,000 words. The papers should never have been published.
Submissions:
Submission period: 1 August 2026 – 31 December 2026
Applicants should submit the application form along with the research paper by email to:
ics-lingnan@cuhk.edu.hk
, with “Lingnan Culture Studies Research Paper Competition 2026-27 (Full name of applicant)” in the subject line.

Announcements
Call for Rural Conservation! Free Training・Paid Internship! Join Us as a Project Ambassador at Yim Tin Tsai  第二屆【智遊自在鹽田梓】項目大使現正接受報名！生態文化導賞實習機會！ - Department of Geography and Resource Management
From: Cherry Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cherrylau123@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【智遊自在鹽田梓】現正招募 第二屆項目大使！
Call for Project Ambassador to work in Yim Tin Tsai, Sai Kung!
熱愛大自然？或是對客家文化與天主教深感興趣？機會來了！
「智遊自在鹽田梓」現正招募第二屆項目大使，計劃費用全免，完成後可獲頒證書，一同參與生態保育與社區導賞工作。
成為項目大使，你可以在遠離煩囂的西貢鹽田梓島上工作，將生態知識、AR科技和社區導賞結合，親身參與鄉郊保育，更可優先報名參加項目活動！
工作體驗包括帶領生態文化導賞，以及協助活動進行
Love nature? Curious about Hakka culture and Catholicism? This is your opportunity!
"Exploring YTT Nature ARchive" is now recruiting for its second cohort (2026/2027) of Project Ambassadors. The programme is free to join, and you will receive free training and a certificate upon completion. Be part of our ecological conservation and community guiding efforts.
As a Project Ambassador, you will work on the Yim Tin Tsai island in Sai Kung, combining ecological knowledge, AR technology, and guided tours. You will also get priority access to project activities. Your role will include leading eco-cultural tours and supporting event operations.
參與資格 Eligibility
：
• 必須為香港中文大學在讀學生（本科生及碩士生均可）Current CUHK student (both undergraduate and postgraduate students are welcome)
• 對生態、客家文化、導賞或保育有興趣 Interest in ecology, Hakka culture, guided tours, or conservation
• 粵語流利，具英語能力更佳 Fluent in Cantonese (English proficiency is an advantage)
• 不怕坐船，熱愛戶外活動 Comfortable with outdoor activities
計劃日程 Programme Schedule
：
• 面試 Interview：Late September to early October 2026 (via Zoom)
• 網上理論課 Online Training：October - November 2026
• 實地考察 Field Visit：Early November 2026 (Yim Tin Tsai Island)
• 實地導賞考核 Tour Examination：November–December 2026 (Optional 如選擇參與導賞工作)
截止報名 Application Deadline: 20 September 2026 (Sunday) 23:59
報名表格 Join Us Now
：
https://forms.gle/wocifws9ndFh9tqV7
Enquiries: Cherry Lau (Project Manager)
cherrylau123@cuhk.edu.hk
══════════
關於我們 About the Project
本項目【智遊自在鹽田梓 Exploring YTT Nature ARchive】（全稱：「西貢鹽田梓生態保育應用研究：擴增模型與智能體驗式參與」）於2024年9月正式開始，為期三年，旨在運用擴增實境技術展示鹽田梓的生物多樣性，將智能科技融入島上自然保育與鄉郊復育工作。
"Exploring YTT Nature ARchive" is a three‑year project (2024–2027) that integrates Augmented Reality (AR) technology with nature conservation and rural revitalisation on Yim Tin Tsai Island. It aims to enhance public awareness and interest in the island's biodiversity through innovative technology and experiential learning.
資助單位 Funders: 鄉郊保育資助計劃、鄉郊保育辦公室 Countryside Conservation Funding Scheme (CCFS), Countryside Conservation Office (CCO)
主辦單位 Organiser: 香港中文大學地理與資源管理學系 Department of Geography and Resource Management
協辦/支持單位 Partners：香港科技大學綜合系統與設計學部、香港戶外生態教育協會、鹽田梓村委會、鹽光保育中心 HKUST Division of Integrative Systems and Design, Outdoor Wildlife Learning Hong Kong (OWLHK), Yim Tin Tsai Village Committee, Salt and Light Preservation Centre
Website:
http://www.yttnaturearchive.org
Facebook: 智遊自在鹽田梓 Exploring YTT Nature ARchive
Instagram: @yttnaturearchive
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

身處香港這座繁囂的都市，你正被焦慮、壓力、失眠或情緒內耗所困嗎？
緊湊的學業與工作節奏、對未來的不確定，是否讓你常感受慮與不安？
誠邀你參加自學中心首次開辦的呼吸禪修班，一起學習佛陀所教導——簡單、有效的呼吸方法。
這套練習將有助你緩解壓力、放鬆身心、培養覺察力，重新找回輕安與自在。


講者：
Karen, Chuen, Faye
畢業於香港大學佛法輔導碩士課程，現正於港大進修專業佛法輔導文憑課程。致力將佛法、心理輔導與現代科學融合，幫助我們守護健康快樂的心。

日期：
10月15日(四) 及 22日(四)
11月12日(四) 及 19日(四)
⏰
時間：
晚上7:30至9:00

地點：
香港中文大學聯合書院胡忠圖書館1樓研討室

對象：
中大學生及教職員

語言：
廣東話
成功完成 3 堂或以上課堂者，可獲贈冥想凳乙張
名額有限，先到先得。現已開放報名：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/workshop/MTE2026/
In the hustle and bustle of Hong Kong, is anxiety, stress, sleeplessness, or emotional fatigue weighing you down?
Amidst demanding schedules and future uncertainties, do you feel anxious and uneasy sometimes?
We warmly invite you to join the Independent Learning Centre’s inaugural Breathing Meditation Class, where we explore simple but profound breathing methods rooted in Buddhist teachings together.
This practice is designed to ease your stress, unwind your body and mind, nurture self-awareness, and help you find your inner peace and tranquillity.


Facilitators:
Karen, Chuen, Faye
Graduated with Master of Buddhist Counselling from The University of Hong Kong, and currently pursuing Postgraduate Diploma in Professional Practice of Buddhist Counselling at HKU, they are dedicated to integrating Buddhist wisdom, psychological counselling, and modern science to help us nurture a healthy and joyful mind.

Date:
15, 22 Oct & 12, 19 Nov (Thursdays)
⏰
Time:
7:30 pm – 9:00 pm

Venue:
Seminar Room, 1/F, Wu Chung Library, United College

Target Audience:
CUHK Students and Staff

Language:
Cantonese

Complete 3 or more sessions to receive a FREE meditation stool
Seats are limited. Register Now at:

Amidst demanding schedules and future uncertainties, do you feel anxious and uneasy sometimes?
We warmly invite you to join the Independent Learning Centre’s inaugural Breathing Meditation Class, where we explore simple but profound breathing methods rooted in Buddhist teachings together.
This practice is designed to ease your stress, unwind your body and mind, nurture self-awareness, and help you find your inner peace and tranquillity.

Announcements
AI+Music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research AI+Music!! 招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xiuyang Meng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究
我們正在尋找熱愛音樂的你，參與人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究，用你的聽感為 AI 模型注入真實的青年情緒視角。
研究目的
本研究旨在運用人工智能技術，從青年視角對粵語流行歌曲進行情緒分類標註，評估青年群體對音樂情緒的主觀感知特徵，並為個性化音樂推薦系統及情緒調節相關研究提供數據支持。
招募條件
18 至 24 歲，熱愛音樂且經常聆聽流行音樂，能流暢使用粵語及英語進行溝通與表達的青年。
參與內容
聆聽 50 首粵語流行歌曲，並完整聽畢每首參與標註的曲目，依據自身主觀體驗與即時情緒感受，將歌曲進行情緒分類。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full, and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Announcements
[Calling for Writing and Arts Talents!] CUHK’s student magazine CUriosity is recruiting Core Members, Writers and Illustrators!  - Office of University General Education
From: Office of University General Education
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
gef-info@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear Students,
Has writing always felt more like an art than an assignment to you? Ever wanted to share big ideas and worthwhile reads? Eager to connect with like-minded students who love writing as much as you? Here comes the perfect chance!
CUriosity
is CUHK’s campus magazine – made by students, for students. For 10 years, we published our thoughts and stories to students in CUHK through magazine publications, which are kindly supported by the General Education Foundation Programme of the Office of University General Education. Our latest issue, Issue 9, will come out soon! (For all of our issues, please go to our instagram @curiositycuhk).
We are now  recruiting
Leadership Positions, Core Members, Writers and Illustrators
for
CUriosity
’s Issue 10! We’re looking for someone dedicated and passionate about collaboration and writing!
Below are the positions for which we are recruiting:
Co-editor-in-chief
Marketing manager
Administrative coordinator
Core members
Writers
Illustrators
Designers

bodyText:

Events / Activities
[Last Chance] Win Round-Trip Tickets with HK Express – Join the Gotta GO! Sustainable Explorer Challenge 2026   - Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development Office
From: Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development Office
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
srsdo@cuhk.edu.hk

Dear Students,
3rd edition of the HK Express Gotta GO! Sustainable Explorer Challenge is back and now open for applications!
Love travel? Want to turn your ideas into a real adventure?
The
3rd HK Express Gotta GO! Sustainable Explorer Challenge
is now open for applications. Team up in pairs, design a
4D3N
lower-carbon travel itinerary
, and compete for the chance to bring your trip to life flying with HK Express!
Prizes & Opportunities
If your team is selected as one of the
5 finalist teams
, you’ll receive:
Round-Trip flight tickets by HK Express
HK$4,000 travel fund per person
The chance to carry out your proposed trip in January 2027
And if your team wins the
Champion
title, each member will also receive an extra set of round-trip tickets to any HK Express destination.
Why join?
You’ll get the chance to:
Learn more about sustainable travel and carbon footprint awareness
Build skills in itinerary design, storytelling and pitching
Present your idea to a judging panel
Gain hands-on experience through a real travel challenge
Meet students from universities across Hong Kong, Macau and other parts of the Greater Bay Area
Who can join?
You must apply in a team of 2 undergraduate students (local or non-local) currently enrolled at one of the following institutions (arranged alphabetically):
Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU)
Lingnan University (Lingnan)
Macao Polytechnic University (MPU)
Macao University of Tourism (UTM)
The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (CUHK SZ)
The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) (HKUST GZ)
Students from different universities may form a team together. Individuals may need to obtain relevant visas or travel permits for entering Hong Kong where applicable.
Interested? How it works:
Fill in the
Programme Briefing Registration
F
orm
and register your preferred
Programme Briefing
session
(Compulsory).
Attend the Programme Briefing to learn about the programme and get exclusive tips from previous winners.
Form a team of 2
and complete the
Application Form
to enroll into the programme and indicate your preferred workshop sessions.
Learn about sustainable tourism, carbon accounting and social media skills through
hands-on workshops
.
Draft your 4D3N
sustainable travel itinerary
following the principles of sustainable tourism and submit your proposal for screening.
Top 30 teams will be invited to a
Pitching Presentation.

will be selected from the pitching presentation to execute their itineraries with sponsorship.

after bringing their itinerary to life, sharing their experience and learnings from the trip with

bodyText:

Announcements
[ RECRUITING! ] Student Helpers in Sleep and Circadian Medicine   - Department of Psychiatry
From: Circadian Lab
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
circadianlab@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
We are recruiting student helpers to support our ongoing clinical research projects on circadian rhythms and mental health at our lab in Shatin Hospital. You will be working collaboratively as a member of the research team. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to clinical research workflows in a hospital setting.
Responsibilities:
Student helpers will play an important role in supporting the research team, with responsibilities mainly involving:
Data entry and data cleaning
Administer neurocognitive tests, questionnaires, and pupillometry assessments
Prepare study materials
Assist with the handling and processing of biological samples
Other ad hoc administrative tasks assigned
Requirements:
Open to students from all disciplines and year levels; a background in psychology, healthcare, or related fields is advantageous.
Fluency in Cantonese is required; proficiency in English is preferred.
Good interpersonal skills and strong attention to detail.
Motivated to gain research experience with a demonstrated strong work ethic.
Experience in data management and familiarity with SPSS or R are preferred.
Working Hours:
We are flexible with your work schedule. Generally, students are expected to commit to 2–4 regular sessions per week, with each session lasting at least 3 hours.
How to apply:
If you are interested in joining us as a student helper, please send your application to us at
circadianlab@cuhk.edu.hk
and include your CV, transcript, and a brief reason for applying. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further consideration.

title: Free Prostate Health Screening‼‼‼ 免費前列腺健康篩查－誠邀合資格男士參加
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/04
»
Events / Activities
Free Prostate Health Screening‼‼‼ 免費前列腺健康篩查－誠邀合資格男士參加 - S.H. Ho Urology Centre, Department of Surgery
From: Yellow Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
根據衛生署數據，前列腺癌是本港男性常見的癌症之一。透過及早篩查，可以有效降低相關的健康風險。本次活動由中大何善衡泌尿中心舉辦，為合資格人士提供免費的前列腺特異抗原 (PSA) 檢測服務。
活動地點： 沙田區（詳細地址將於成功報名後通知）
活動內容：(所需時間約一小時)
1. 影片講解：深入淺出地介紹前列腺增生及前列腺癌的檢查與治療知識。
2. 前列腺篩查：合資格人士可獲免費前列腺特異抗原（PSA）測試乙次.
• 測試方式：我們將以指尖採血方式為參加者抽取血液樣本，並透過PSA檢測機進行現場測試，約十分鐘即可得知結果。
參加資格：
• 性別：男性
• 年齡：50-75歲
• 從未接受前列腺相關檢查
如有興趣參加活動，請填妥以下表格。
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
如想了解更多關於前列腺癌風險的評估, 可瀏覽以下網址;
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cance
r
參加者提供的所有資料將會被保密。如有任何查詢，請與我們聯絡 （Whatsapp: 5160 6904；電郵：yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk）。
According to data from the Department of Health, prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers among men in Hong Kong. Early screening can effectively reduce related health risks. This event is organized by the S.H. Ho Urology Centre of CUHK, providing free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) testing services for eligible individuals.
Event Venue: Shatin District (the exact address will be provided after successful registration)
Event Details: (Estimated duration: about one hour)
Video Presentation: An easy-to-understand introduction to the examination and treatment of prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia
Prostate Screening: Eligible participants will receive one free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) test.
Testing Method: We will collect blood samples from participants via a fingertip blood test and conduct an on-site PSA test using a PSA testing device. Results will be available in about ten minutes.
Eligibility:
Gender: Male
Age: 50-75 years old
Have never undergone any prostate-related examination
If you are interested in participating, please fill in the online form below;
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
For more information about the assessment of prostate cancer risk, please visit the following website:
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cancer
All information provided by participants will be kept confidential. For any enquiries, please contact us (WhatsApp: 5160 6904; Email: yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk)
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
Call for Paper Deadline Extension – NextGen Experience Summit (Submit Abstract by 14 September 2026)  - School of Hotel and Tourism Management
From: Ms Janet Leung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
janet.leung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Good news! The deadline for abstract submission to the NextGen Experience Summit has been extended to 14 September 2026!
Please join us in Hong Kong from
11–13 December 2026
as we explore
Reimagining Sports, Tourism, and Beyond
.
We are accepting abstracts across a wide range of topics, including:
Active Aging, Health, Well-Being, and Quality of Life
Digital Business, Analytics, and AI
E-sports, Betting, and Competitive Entertainment
GBA Sport Economy and Economic Impact
Retail, Merchandise, and Licensing
Sport Consumer Behavior and Fan Economy
Sport Tourism and Destination Experiences
The Experience Economy
Venues, Facilities, Events, and Hospitality
Women in Sport, DEI, and Social Responsibility
Workforce, Talent, and Leadership Development
Don't miss this opportunity to share your research and connect with fellow graduate students, scholars and industry professionals.
Summit Date: 11-13 December 2026
Venue: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Scan the QR code to submit your abstract
More Information at:
https://nextgensummit.hk/en/
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

title: HK$300Brain Health Study HK$300中大醫學院邀您參與腦部健康研究
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/04
»
Announcements
HK$300Brain Health Study  HK$300中大醫學院邀您參與腦部健康研究 - CUHK Psychiatry Sleep Assessment Unit
From: Wong Yuen Tung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yuentungwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
便秘？嗅覺變差？睡覺拳打腳踢？有腦退化家族史？
這些看似平常的小毛病，其實可能是柏金遜症等大腦退化的早期先兆！
提早了解大腦健康，預防神經退化！
中大醫學院睡眠研究小組推出全新手機篩查App，誠邀您參與醫學研究！
研究對象：
年齡介乎
50 至 65 歲
的華人
未確診
任何腦神經退化疾病（如柏金遜症、阿爾茲海默症/失智症等）
參加者需完成以下程序：
參與研究
費用全免
，成功完成相關研究程序者最多可獲
HK$300元超市禮券
作為津貼
階段一：
下載手機程式並完成問卷 （約需 15–20 分鐘）
完成後可獲得早期柏金遜病風險分數
符合資格並完成問卷者可獲 HK$100元超市禮券
階段二：
部分參加者將獲邀進一步參與臨床評估
包括身體檢查、臨床訪談、居家睡眠測試及神經認知測試
符合資格並完成階段二者，可額外獲 HK$200元超市禮券
立刻掃描海報右下方
二維碼 (QR Code)
或
點擊連結
下載程式「柏健通」參與研究
IOS用戶：
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android用戶：
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
查詢（致電或WhatsApp）：3919 7792 / 5282 5786（研究助理 黃小姐）
Constipated？Weakened sense of smell？Acting out dream during sleep (punching and kicking) ？Having a family history of neurodegenerative disease？
Common issues like these can actually be early warning signs of brain degeneration, including neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s disease.
Understand your brain health early to prevent neurodegeneration.
Sleep Assessment Unit - Psychiatry, CUHK has launched a brand-new screening App, and we sincerely invite you to join our medical research study.
Target participants：
Chinese aged between 50 to 65 years old
Have NOT been diagnosed
with any neurodegenerative disease (e.g. Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease/ Dementia, etc.)
What you will need to do:
Participation is completely free. Those who successfully complete the study procedure can receive up to HK$300 in supermarket voucher as an allowance.
Phase 1:
Download the mobile app "柏健通" and complete the questionnaires (take approximately 15-20 minutes)
An early Parkinson’s disease risk score will be provided upon completion
Eligible participants who complete the questionnaires will receive HK$100 supermarket voucher
Phase 2:
Selected participants will be invited to undergo further clinical assessments
Assessments include physical examination, clinical interviews, sleep studies, and neurocognitive assessments
Eligible participants who complete Phase 2 will receive an additional HK$200 supermarket voucher
Interested parties are welcome to participate by
clicking the links below
or
scanning the QR Code
in the poster to download the "柏健通" mobile application:
IOS users:
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android users:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
For details and registration enquiries, please contact our hotline: 39197792 or 5282 5786 (WhatsApp) (Research Assistant, Ms Wong)
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Announcements
Are you a Self-Critical person? Male Cantonese Speakers Participant Recruitment[Free of Charge] Magic Chair Experiment 想跳出自責的循環？「魔法椅子」自我關懷對話實驗 男性參與者招募【費用全免】 識廣東話【完成後可獲一份心理問卷報告】 - Department of Psychology
From: Chu Long Yiu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155211898@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
「魔法椅子」自我關懷對話實驗 參與者招募 
心裡一直有把聲音告訴你不夠好？因此感到困擾，並想要減少批評自己？
香港中文大學心理學系 臨床心理科學實驗室 誠邀你參與有趣嘅心理學研究！
我們希望研究人們在受挫時，內心會如何與自己對話，而這些聲音會如何影響心理健康。
完成研究流程可獲一份心理問卷報告
招募對象：
年滿 18 歲
識廣東話
男性
生活受自我批評困擾者
研究內容：
線上前測問卷
約 1.5 小時實驗室實驗
2 星期後線上後測問卷
地點：香港中文大學 王福元樓102室
有興趣參加？請透過以下連結報名：
https://esurvey.psy.cuhk.edu.hk/jfe/form/SV_eJcE6LGxl0xhfW6
此研究已通過香港中文大學調查和行為研究倫理的審核。
如有任何疑問，歡迎聯絡我們！
電郵： ybxie@link.cuhk.edu.hk（研究負責人 Yanbin）
—————————————————————————————————————————
Magic Chair Experiment – Recruitment of participants 
Is there an inner voice keep telling you that you are good enough? You feel distressed about this and wish to stop criticizing yourself?
Experimental Psychopathology and Psychotherapy Laboratory, Department of Psychology at CUHK, is inviting you to join this interesting study.
We would like to know more about how people’s inner voice and interaction within oneself when facing struggles, and how these inner voice affects individual’s mental health.
You will receive a personalized questionnaire report after finishing the study.

Eligible participants:
Aged 18 or above
Able to speak and understand Cantonese
Male
Distressed about self-criticism

Study Overview:
Online questionnaire before the experiment
In-person experiment at the laboratory (lasts for approximately 1.5 hour)
Follow-up online questionnaire at 2 weeks after the experiment
 Location: Room 102, Wong Foo Yuan Building, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin, N.T., Hong Kong SAR
 If you are interested in this study, please click the link below for application.
https://esurvey.psy.cuhk.edu.hk/jfe/form/SV_eJcE6LGxl0xhfW6
This study is approved by the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics (SBRE) of the Chinese University of Hong Kong.
 For enquiries, please feel free to contact Yanbin Xie at
ybxie@link.cuhk.edu.hk
.

Consultation Sessions for PhD and MPhil in Communication Programmes
The 2027-2028 Research Postgraduate Programmes (PhD and MPhil) of the School of Journalism and Communication, the Chinese University of Hong Kong, are now open for application. The School will hold several consultation sessions 21-23 & 26 October 2026 via Zoom.
Each session will be hosted by one of our research faculty members and conducted in a focus group format. Participants will have the opportunity to discuss their research plans, explore the programme structure and financial support in detail, and ask any questions they may have about admissions, studying at CUHK, etc. Those who are planning to apply for PhD and MPhil programmes (2027 Intake) are strongly encouraged to attend one of the sessions before submitting their application.
Date
: 21-23 & 26 October 2026
Time
: 1.5 hours (to be allocated by the School)
Format
: online via Zoom
Hosts
: Research faculty from the School
Registration
:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13739604
More about our PhD and MPhil Programmes:
https://rpg.com.cuhk.edu.hk/
.
Please note that the consultation sessions are specifically for PhD and MPhil applicants (2027 Intake). The School of Journalism and Communication offers six Taught Postgraduate Programmes for 2027-28 intake, including:

Learn a new language in Term 1: French, German, Korean &Spanish
Modern Language Minor Programmes at CUHK
In Term 1, 2026-27, don’t miss out on this great chance to:
* learn a language and its culture or advance existing language skills
* have fun with our interactive approach, and
* earn 3 credits per course on top of that!
The Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages at CUHK cordially invites you to join our Modern Languages courses from our Minor Programmes in the Term 1 of 2026-27.
Course Selection & On-line Registration
(via CUSIS) for the coming semester (Term 1, 2026-27) (Please check CUSIS for your designated registration period.)
E-add/drop period on CUSIS
14 – 20 September 2026
(Mon, 8:30 pm – Sun 8:30 pm)
For more information, please subscribe to our Instagram accounts:
French:
cuhk_french_programme
German:
cuhk_german
Korean:
cuhk_korean
Spanish:
elecafelito
Hong Kong Sign Language:
HKSL.CUHK
Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages:
CUHK.LING.ML
There are many practical benefits and advantages in language learning, in particular, an increased competitiveness. Our graduate survey shows that a large proportion of our graduates found their language training in the ML programme useful for their current job. Some explicitly stated that they are currently working or have been working with a company from the country of their target language or even in the country of the target language.
From beginner to more advanced levels, come and enjoy learning:
French, German, Korean, and Spanish
Eligibility:
All CUHK full-time undergraduate and MPhil/PhD students
Instructor & Venue:
Please refer to the website of Registration and Examinations Section (
http://www.res.cuhk.edu.hk
) for the details of the teaching timetable of the year of 2026-27.
You can also contact our language coordinators for more information:
French: Mr. Benjamin Gaudet
benjamin.gaudet@cuhk.edu.hk
German: Mr. Bernd Esch
berndesch@cuhk.edu.hk
Korean: Ms. Sehee Park
sehee.park@cuhk.edu.hk
Spanish: Mr. Antonio Garcia Susperregui
antoniorgarciasusperregui@cuhk.edu.hk
For more details on our course details on our Department’s
website
.
Remarks:
The units earned will be counted towards fulfillment of requirements for your minor programme and graduation.
For questions, please contact our Department General Office at 3943 9836 or via email to modernlang@link.cuhk.edu.hk.
See you in our courses!

[Paid Student Helper Opportunity] 2026-27 Happy Ageing Lab Recruitment for Student Helpers  - School of Architecture
From: Happy Ageing Lab Foundation
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
kelvinchui@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
About Us
Happy Ageing Lab
(https://www.happyageinglab.com/) is a social innovation initiative based at The Chinese University of Hong Kong. We advocate revamping the design and management of our built environment for healthy ageing through participatory research, co-design workshops, and interdisciplinary collaborations to shape a supportive and inclusive community for older adults.
Who We Are Looking For:
We are currently recruiting passionate
undergraduate and postgraduate students from CUHK
to join our team as Student Helpers for upcoming projects.
Job
Responsibilities:
Selected helpers will assist with various
on-site / remote
tasks on an ad-hoc basis, including:
- Assisting in workshops and community activities
- Conducting interviews and community surveys
- Audio transcription and document translation
- Supporting desk research and literature reviews
- Multimedia production using Adobe Creative Suite and/or Canva (e.g., social media content, graphics, videos)
- On-site event helpers / workshop note-takers
Remuneration & Working Arrangement:
Hourly Rate: HK$64/hour
(Standard CUHK Student Helper rate)
Arrangement:
Upon successful recruitment, you will be added to our WhatsApp group, where helper opportunities and assignment details will be posted from time to time. You can opt for tasks that fit your availability.
Application & Deadline:
If you are interested in working with us, please complete the application by
13 September 2026
.
Google Form:
https://forms.gle/jeUxtzVKTyN2LNMU6
We will get in touch with you soon if you are selected. Thank you!

Participants needed for experimental study (HKD200) 實驗被試招募（200港幣） - Dept. of Psychology
From: Yuxuan ZHENG
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
zhyx@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The Cognitive Psychology Lab is recruiting university students to participate in an experimental study about multilingual language production. This experiment is endorsed by Prof. HUANG Liqiang (
lqhuang@psy.cuhk.edu.hk
) from the Department of Psychology, CUHK.
Location: Sino Building, Chung Chi College
Tasks:
You will take part in the experiments in a lab on separate days. You will be presented with pictures of common objects, and you need to name these pictures one by one in a designated language (i.e., Cantonese, Mandarin, or English).
You will also complete a language background questionnaire, do some rating on the pictures (e.g., familiarity), and complete some cognitive tasks (e.g., working memory tasks).
Duration and Payment:
Day 1: 60-70 mins (HKD70)
Day 2: 50-60 mins (HKD65)
Day 3: 50-60 mins (HKD65)
Requirements:
18-30 years old, university students
Cantonese as your first language, Mandarin and English as your native or non-native languages
Grew up in Hong Kong
No history of uncorrected sensory impairments or neurological disorders
If you are interested, please sign up through this link:
https://forms.gle/AMGhYw31vKx9v4iMA
. You will be contacted by email for further instructions.
This study is in collaboration with Dr. WANG Jie of The Department of Psychology, Education University of Hong Kong. Please contact Miss WANG Ziyi Pearl <cogpsy339@gmail.com> for any enquiries.
Thank you for your interest!
On Behalf of WANG Ziyi, Pearl

Programme Overview:
The
MSc in
Clinical Gerontology and End-of-life Care Programme
provides comprehensive knowledge and training for professionals involved in the
care of older people
and in
end-of-life care
in diverse settings.
The core modules cover biological, social and clinical gerontology, service models for older people, palliative care, and ethical principles in end-of life care. Elective modules focus on epidemiology, research methods, geriatric medicine, symptom control and end-of-life care. Designed to support
healthcare professionals
and students from
social work
backgrounds.
The 2027/28 academic year will commence in September 2027. Students may choose to pursue the programme on

or

basis.

2026–2027****

課程對象
負責或協助籌辦及帶領學生活動的現職中、小學教師，尤以現任及新任課外活動主任、全方位學習統籌主任、新高中「其他學習經歷」統籌主任、「學生學習概覽」統籌主任及課程發展主任為合。需持有教師資歷及認可大學之學士學位。

This programme is designed to respond to the development of student activities and to accommodate the needs of professional training of educators.
Target Participants
Serving teachers in primary or secondary schools who are responsible for or involved in organizing and managing student activities, and holders of teacher qualification and a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

The curriculum consists of four compulsory modules and one elective module, a total of 126 hours.

  [Online experiment] Looking for native English speakers
Prof. Haerim Hwang (Department of English, CUHK) is looking for participants for a study on language production.
Which participants are we looking for?
- English is your first/native and dominant language
- Your graduate degree is not in the field of linguistics
- Can use your laptop/computer and have access to stable internet (no smartphones, laptops, or hotspot)
- Can participate in an experiment on Zoom in a quiet environment
- Have Chrome on your laptop/computer
How do I participate?
1. Fill out this questionnaire
-- English speakers: https://forms.gle/ttuhGGCwRx2n95kBA
2. Our research team will reach out to you, confirming your availability.
3. It will take approximately 2 hours to complete these tasks.
What do I get out of the study?
You will get HK$250 in cash upon the completion of the task.
Your participation will enhance our understanding of how people process English sentences.
Questions?
Contact Prof. Haerim Hwang at haerimhwang@cuhk.edu.hk
Ethics Approval
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee SBREC (fssc02@cuhk.edu.hk) has vetted the study (Approval ID: SBRE-22-0026D). If you have any concerns regarding ethics, please contact them.

‼~ ( Maximum $5⃣0⃣0⃣allowance!) Recruiting youths (aged 15–24) for online self-help mental health treatment study ~‼ ‼~誠邀15至24歲青年參加網上自助心理健康療程研究（最高可獲得$5⃣0⃣0⃣津貼！） ~‼ - Department of Psychiatry
From: Winifred Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，旨在評估手機應用程式網上自助心理健康療程對改善青年睡眠及情緒健康的成效。現招募年齡介乎15歲至24歲青年研究。詳情如下:
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
1. 15歲至24歲青年
2. 有失眠及情緒症狀
3. 過去三個月沒有接受失眠及情緒心理治療或藥物治療
您需要做什麼？
參與為期6週的手機App自助療程
每週觀看20分鐘左右的網上療程
完成四次網上問卷及七天睡眠日記，包括治療前、治療後、三個月跟進及六個月跟進
全部評估及治療皆在電話或網上進行，無需面見！
如有興趣，請即登記並填寫簡單的網上篩查問卷：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_domAhEzzCmdV2sK
研究小組將會聯絡適合參與本研究的人士並進一步解釋研究詳情。閣下登記時留下的資料僅供研究用途，絕對保密。如閣下對是項研究有任何查詢，請電郵
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
或 WhatsApp: (+852- 47544464 黃小姐)查詢。
The Department of Psychiatry at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a research study to evaluate the effectiveness of an online self-help mobile app program for improving sleep and emotional well-being among youths. We would like to invite participants aged between 15 and 24 to join the study. Details are as follows:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Youths aged between 15-24 years
2. Experience symptoms of insomnia and emotional distress
3. Have not received psychological or medication treatment for these issues in the past 3 months
What will you do?
Join a 6-week self-help treatment via mobile app
Attend 20 minutes of online therapy weekly
Complete four online surveys and seven-day sleep diary: before treatment, after treatment, at 3-month follow-up, and at 6-month follow-up during the study
All assessments and treatments are conducted via phone or online — no in-person visits required!
If you are interested, please register and complete a short screening questionnaire here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_domAhEzzCmdV2sK
The research team will contact eligible participants and further explain the details of the study. Information collected will be only used for research purpose and will be kept strictly confidential. If you have any enquiries, please contact us via email
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
or WhatsApp: (+852- 47544464 Miss Wong).

Inclusion criteria:
1. Youths aged between 15-24 years
2. Experience symptoms of insomnia and emotional distress
3. Have not received psychological or medication treatment for these issues in the past 3 months
What will you do?
Join a 6-week self-help treatment via mobile app
Attend 20 minutes of online therapy weekly
Complete four online surveys and seven-day sleep diary: before treatment, after treatment, at 3-month follow-up, and at 6-month follow-up during the study
All assessments and treatments are conducted via phone or online — no in-person visits required!

title: 【$100 Coupon 】CUHK Allergy Team is Recruiting Healthy Children for Immune Testing 中大過敏科團隊誠邀非食物過敏兒童參與兒童免疫多組學圖譜研究
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/04
»
Announcements
【$100 Coupon 】CUHK Allergy Team is Recruiting Healthy Children for Immune Testing  中大過敏科團隊誠邀非食物過敏兒童參與兒童免疫多組學圖譜研究 - Department of Paediatrics
From: Ann Au
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
annwsau@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
疾病與腸道微生態息息相關，中大兒科過敏科團隊正在研究兒童食物過敏的成因及治療方案。您的孩子的血液及糞便樣本有助我們科研團隊更了解兒童食物過敏與腸道微生態等多組學的關係，更對濕疹、哮喘、鼻敏感等其他免疫系統疾病提供寶貴的參考，對未來的科研發展作出巨大的貢獻。
以下表格將會收集基本資料，以便研究團隊評核您／您的孩子是否合適參與此研究。如果您／您的孩子被選中，研究團隊將會聯絡您，並安排到威爾斯親王醫院 (Prince of Wales Hospital) 再詳細解釋研究流程及簽署同意書。 研究團隊會為參加者抽取血液及糞便樣本。參加者在完成該研究後可獲港幣$100餐飲券、血液報告乙份及腸道微生態報告乙份。
研究團隊會在閣下填妥表格一個月內聯絡合資格的申請者，假如申請一個月後團隊未有聯絡閣下，代表閣下未能通過初步篩選。
您所提供的資料會用作日後聯絡之用，只有獲本研究團隊授權人員方可查閱。如果您／您的孩子對填寫申請表格或研究詳情有任何疑問，請於辦公時間聯絡 9671 1756 查詢。
申請表格連結：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3yNko4UyWrBHCJg
==================================================================
As many diseases are closely related to the gut microbiome, the CUHK Paediatric Allergy team is currently investigating the causes of paediatric food allergy and its treatments. Your child’s blood and stool samples could enable our team to understand more about the relationship between food allergy and multi-omics fields, such as the gut microbiome. It would also serve as a valuable reference for other immunological diseases such as eczema, asthma, and allergic rhinitis, contributing greatly to future scientific research.
The team will assess if you/your child’s eligibility to participate in this study with the form linked below. The team will contact you if you/your child is eligible, and arrange a session at the Prince of Wales Hospital for detailed study explanation and signature of consent forms.
The team will collect blood and stool samples from participants in this study. Participants will receive HK$100 food voucher, a blood test report, and a gut microbiome report after completion of the study.
The team will contact eligible participants within one month of receiving your form submission. You have not been selected to participate in the study if the team has not contacted you in a month.
All information collected will be used for contact purposes only and will only be accessible to authorised personnel. Should you/your child have any questions regarding form submission or study details, please call 9671 1756 within office hours.
Registration form link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3yNko4UyWrBHCJg
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

title: HK$300!! Brain Health Study HK$300!! 中大醫學院邀您參與腦部健康研究
bodyText:

»
2026/09/04
»
Announcements
HK$300!! Brain Health Study  HK$300!! 中大醫學院邀您參與腦部健康研究 - CUHK Psychiatry Sleep Assessment Unit
From: Wong Yuen Tung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yuentungwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
便秘？嗅覺變差？睡覺拳打腳踢？有腦退化家族史？
這些看似平常的小毛病，其實可能是柏金遜症等大腦退化的早期先兆！
提早了解大腦健康，預防神經退化！
中大醫學院睡眠研究小組推出全新手機篩查App，誠邀您參與醫學研究！
研究對象：
年齡介乎
50 至 65 歲
的華人
未確診
任何腦神經退化疾病（如柏金遜症、阿爾茲海默症/失智症等）
參加者需完成以下程序：
參與研究
費用全免
，成功完成相關研究程序者最多可獲
HK$300元超市禮券
作為津貼
階段一：
下載手機程式並完成問卷 （約需 15–20 分鐘）
完成後可獲得早期柏金遜病風險分數
符合資格並完成問卷者可獲 HK$100元超市禮券
階段二：
部分參加者將獲邀進一步參與臨床評估
包括身體檢查、臨床訪談、居家睡眠測試及神經認知測試
符合資格並完成階段二者，可額外獲 HK$200元超市禮券
立刻掃描海報右下方
二維碼 (QR Code)
或
點擊連結
下載程式「柏健通」參與研究
IOS用戶：
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android用戶：
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
查詢（致電或WhatsApp）：3919 7792 / 5282 5786（研究助理 黃小姐）
Constipated？Weakened sense of smell？Acting out dream during sleep (punching and kicking) ？Having a family history of neurodegenerative disease？
Common issues like these can actually be early warning signs of brain degeneration, including neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s disease.
Understand your brain health early to prevent neurodegeneration.
Sleep Assessment Unit - Psychiatry, CUHK has launched a brand-new screening App, and we sincerely invite you to join our medical research study.
Target participants：
Chinese aged between 50 to 65 years old
Have NOT been diagnosed
with any neurodegenerative disease (e.g. Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease/ Dementia, etc.)
What you will need to do:
Participation is completely free. Those who successfully complete the study procedure can receive up to HK$300 in supermarket voucher as an allowance.
Phase 1:
Download the mobile app "柏健通" and complete the questionnaires (take approximately 15-20 minutes)
An early Parkinson’s disease risk score will be provided upon completion
Eligible participants who complete the questionnaires will receive HK$100 supermarket voucher
Phase 2:
Selected participants will be invited to undergo further clinical assessments
Assessments include physical examination, clinical interviews, sleep studies, and neurocognitive assessments
Eligible participants who complete Phase 2 will receive an additional HK$200 supermarket voucher
Interested parties are welcome to participate by
clicking the links below
or
scanning the QR Code
in the poster to download the "柏健通" mobile application:
IOS users:
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android users:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
For details and registration enquiries, please contact our hotline: 39197792 or 5282 5786 (WhatsApp) (Research Assistant, Ms Wong)

bodyText:
